picture-pairs.name: Mfonini a ɛtoatoa
picture-pairs.seoTitle: Memory Game for Adults: Picture Pairs
picture-pairs.h1: Mfonini Mmienu: Dwumadie a Ɛtoatoa a Ɛyɛ Brɛoo
picture-pairs.description: A free, gentle matching game for adults and older adults, including people living with dementia. Pictures can stay showing. No timer or score.
picture-pairs.short: Hwehwɛ mfonini abien a ɛte sɛ ɛno. Mfonini no bɛtena hɔ.
picture-pairs.players: Obi 1 anaa 2, wɔn ho ne ho
picture-pairs.intro: Tɔ mfonini bi, afei tɔ no a ɛte sɛ ɛno. Mfonini bɛtena hɔ de, enti ɛnsɛ sɛ wobɛkae biribi. Sɛ mfonini abien yɛ pɛ a, wɔde kɔn kɔkɔɔ ne tikɛ bi bɛka wɔn ho.
howTo: Paw nea wɔbɛde mfonini no bɛyɛ. Mfonini 4 yɛ beaeɛ a ɛyɛ dwodwo sɛ wobɛhyehyɛ.
Tɔ mfonini biara. Ɛbɛnya kɔkɔɔ bi ho.
Tɔ mfonini a ɛte sɛ ɛno. Mmienu no bɛtena hɔ, ɛne tikɛ.
Sɛ mfonini abien no nyinaa yɛ mmerɛ a, biribi bɔne rennyɛ. San tɔ bio bere a wo ho yɛ wo.
Gyina "Mfonini a wɔakata" so kɛse sɛ wo ne obi no pɛ sɛ moyɛ dwumadie no wɔ kwan a wɔakata mfonini no so.
tips: Frɛ mfonini no mu biara ka ho ne wo ne obi no bom: "Ɛyɛ ɔkyena a ɛyɛ fitaa. Wopɛ sɛ wode nufɔ gu tee mu?"
Ma obi a woboa no no ntɔ, ɛwom sɛ ɛbɛfa bere pii. Fa nsa to baabi a ɛbɛyɛ, mma wo ankasa wo ntɔ ma wɔn.
Gyina mfonini anan ho sɛ ɛyɛ wo dwodwo. Mfonini pii yɛ owura a wopaw, ɛnyɛ ɔkwan a wobɛfa so ahyɛ.
Gyae dwumadie no bere a ɛda so ara yɛ wo anigye. Dwumadie baako nso ara yɛ adwuma a ɛyɛ mu.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ bere anaa nsɛnkyerɛnne ho?
faq.a: Dabi. Ɛnni wotchman, nsɛnkyerɛnne, nkaeɛ anaa atwitwa. Wubetumi agyae bere biara, na ɛyɛ mmerɛ sɛ wugyae ɛberɛ a wɔaka mu.

faq.q: Adɛn nti na mfonini no tena hɔ?
faq.a: Sɛ mfonini hɔ hyɛ hɔ a, dwumadie no yɛ hwehwɛ ne mfonini a wɔtoatoa, ɛnyɛ sɛ wobɛkae nea wɔayɛ. Nnipa pii hu sɛ ɛma wɔn ani gye ankasa. Sɛ wopɛ a, wubetumi asesa kɔ "Mfonini a wɔakata" wɔ nkɔ a ɛyɛ mmerɛ.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ free anaa ɛsɛ sɛ mekyerɛw din?
faq.a: Ɛyɛ, ɛnhwɛ sika, na ɛnhia akaunt, ankyerɛw din anaa nea wobɛtu fi. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ web browser wɔ foon, tablet anaa komputa so.

faq.q: Yɛn ankasa mfonini a yɛn abusuafoɔ ho wɔ hɔ de bɛtumi ayɛ?
faq.a: Yiw. Sɔ hwɛ "Mfonini Mmienu a Wɔde Yɛ", a ɛma woapaw mfonini a wɔwɔ wo foon so. Mfonini no bɛtena wo browser mu, na wɔrenkɔ soro.

find-the-same.name: Hwehwɛ ɛne no pɛ
find-the-same.seoTitle: Find the Same Picture: Simple Picture Game
find-the-same.h1: Hwehwɛ Mfonini a Ɛte Sɛ Ɛno
find-the-same.description: One picture at the top, two to four below. Tap the one that is the same. A calm, free picture game for adults, older adults and families, with no timer.
find-the-same.short: Hwɛ mfonini a ɛwɔ soro, na tɔ ɛno a ɛte sɛ ɛno a ɛwɔ fam.
find-the-same.intro: Mfonini baako wɔ ɔpon no soro. Ase no wɔ mfonini mmienu, mmiɛnsa anaa anan. Tɔ nea ɛte sɛ ɛno. Ɛyɛ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ mmerɛ, baako baako, na beaeɛ pii ma mo ka ho.
howTo: Paw mfonini mmienu, mmiɛnsa anaa anan a wobɛpaw. Mmienu yɛ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ mmerɛ.
Hwɛ soro mfonini no bom.
Tɔ mfonini a ɛte sɛ ɛno a ɛwɔ fam. Ɛbɛyɛ tikɛ ne nsɛm kɔkɔɔ bi.
Sɛ wɔtɔ mfonini a ɛnte saa a, dwumadie no kyerɛ din na ɛtra hɔ. Fa bere.
Tɔ "Mfonini a Edi So" sɛ wo ne obi no ahyɛ de bio.
tips: Ka mfonini biara ho ansa na wapaw: mfonini no nsusuwii, nkyɛn ne baabi a wubetumi ahu.
Nneyɛe abien nyɛ "ɛyɛ mmerɛ paa". Ɛho nhia ne anigye, ɛnyɛ ɔsɔhwɛ.
Sɛ ɛyɛ den sɛ wobɛtɔ a, obi no betumi ayɛ nkɔnkɔn, na wo nso wobetumi atɔ ma no.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ bere anaa nsɛnkyerɛnne ho?
faq.a: Dabi. Ɛnni wotchman, nsɛnkyerɛnne, nkaeɛ anaa atwitwa. Wubetumi agyae bere biara, na ɛyɛ mmerɛ sɛ wugyae ɛberɛ a wɔaka mu.

faq.q: Dɛn na ɛba sɛ wɔtɔ mfonini a ɛnte saa?
faq.a: Biribi a ɛyɛ hu biara nni hɔ. Ɛnni nnwom ayɛ, ɛnni kɔkɔɔ a ɛyɛ fitaa anaa nkɔneɛ. Dwumadie no kyerɛ mfonini a wɔtɔɔ no din na ɛtra hɔ de ma nea edi so tɔ.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ free anaa ɛsɛ sɛ mekyerɛw din?
faq.a: Ɛyɛ, ɛnhwɛ sika, na ɛnhia akaunt, ankyerɛw din anaa nea wobɛtu fi. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ web browser wɔ foon, tablet anaa komputa so.

shadow-match.name: Sum a ɛne mfonini pɛ
shadow-match.seoTitle: Shadow Matching Game: Free Online for Adults
shadow-match.h1: Sum a Ɛne Mfonini Pɛ: Dwumadie a Ɛyɛ Brɛoo ma Mfonini
shadow-match.description: A dark shadow at the top, two to four pictures below. Tap the picture that makes the shadow. A free, calm shadow matching game with no timer.
shadow-match.short: Hwɛ sum no na tɔ mfonini a ɛyɛ sum no.
shadow-match.intro: Sum a ɛne mfonini pɛ yɛ adwuma a nnipa pɛ ne ho wɔ nkyekyɛmu a wɔde ntwa so. Ɛnyɛ saa, ɛwɔ mfonini kɛseɛ, na ɛnhia sɛ wɔntwa biribi. Sum a ɛyɛ nwini bi tena soro, na mfonini mmienu, mmiɛnsa anaa anan wɔ fam. Tɔ mfonini a ɛyɛ sum no. Nneɛma te sɛ pɔkɔɔ, akyɛde anaa tii nkwan nso yɛ nea ɛyɛ ka ho.
howTo: Paw mfonini mmienu, mmiɛnsa anaa anan a wobɛpaw. Mmienu yɛ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ mmerɛ.
Hwɛ sum no bom. Ɛyɛ dɛn? Ɛyɛ kɔkɔɔ anaa ɛtɔ so?
Tɔ mfonini a ɛyɛ sum no. Ne din bɛda sum no ase.
Sɛ wɔtɔ mfonini a ɛnte saa a, dwumadie no kyerɛ din na ɛtra hɔ. Fa bere.
Tɔ "Sum a Edi So" sɛ wo ne obi no ahyɛ de bio.
tips: Fa nsa to sum no ntwa ne nkyɛn, na ka ne tebea ho asɛm.
Sɛ sum no yɛ den nnɛ a, sesa kɔ "Hwehwɛ ɛne no pɛ", baabi a mfonini no te sɛ ɛno.
Ka mfonini no ho asɛm sɛ wɔahu no: "Yɛn nso nyaa sɛ ɛno a."

faq.q: Ɛwɔ bere anaa nsɛnkyerɛnne ho?
faq.a: Dabi. Ɛnni wotchman, nsɛnkyerɛnne, nkaeɛ anaa atwitwa. Wubetumi agyae bere biara, na ɛyɛ mmerɛ sɛ wugyae ɛberɛ a wɔaka mu.

faq.q: Can people living with dementia enjoy shadow matching?
faq.a: Many adults enjoy it, including some people living with dementia, often in the earlier stages. Shapes are easier to recognize than words. It is for enjoyment and conversation, not a test, and it does not treat or slow dementia. If it causes frustration, try Find the same or simply look at pictures together.

faq.q: Dɛn na ɛba sɛ wotow mfonini a ɛnyɛ no?
faq.a: Biribi a ɛyɛ basaa biara nni hɔ. Ɛnni dwoo, ɛnni ntoma a ɛyɛ kɔkɔɔ, anaa ɛnyɛ nkɔkɔ. Kɔmputa no kyerɛ din a wɔatow no na ɛtwɛn sɛ wobɛtow ɔfoforo.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ bɛn, na ɛhia sɛ mede account bɔ?
faq.a: Aane, ɛnhwɛ tua biara, na ɛnhia account, sign-up anaa download. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ web browser wɔ foon, tablet anaa kɔmputa so.

four-together.name: Four together
four-together.seoTitle: Picture Grouping Game for Adults: Four Together
four-together.h1: Four Together: a Calm Picture Grouping Game
four-together.description: Some of the pictures share a theme, such as fruit or weather. Tap the ones that go together. A free, calm grouping game with no timer and no score.
four-together.short: Find the pictures that go together, like fruit or weather.
four-together.intro: A small set of pictures, and some of them belong together: four kinds of fruit, perhaps, or four ways to travel. Tap the ones that share a theme. If a picture goes with something else, the game simply names it and waits. After a quiet pause a hint names the theme, and "Show the group" reveals the answer at any time.
howTo: Choose four, six or eight pictures. Four is the simplest, with three that go together.
Look at the pictures together and talk about what they have in common.
Tap each picture that belongs in the group. It gets a gold border and a check mark.
If a picture goes with something else, the game names it and waits. Take your time.
Tap "Show the group" whenever you like, then "Another set" for new pictures.
tips: Say what you notice out loud: "These two are both things to eat."
There is no rush. A hint naming the theme appears after a pause, and you can ignore it.
Talk about the group once it is found: a favorite fruit, a train journey, the weather today.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: What happens if a picture from outside the group is tapped?
faq.a: Nothing unpleasant. There is no buzzer, red cross or shaking. The game names the picture, says it goes with something else, and waits for the next tap.

faq.q: What are the groups?
faq.a: Everyday themes that need no special knowledge: fruit, animals, flowers, weather, ways to travel, things for a hot drink and things baked in an oven. Each picture belongs to just one group.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

odd-one-out.name: Odd one out
odd-one-out.seoTitle: Odd One Out Picture Game for Adults
odd-one-out.h1: Odd One Out: a Relaxed Picture Game
odd-one-out.description: Three or four pictures, and all but one share a theme, such as fruit or weather. Tap the one that does not belong. Free, calm, no timer and no score.
odd-one-out.short: Spot the picture that does not belong with the others.
odd-one-out.intro: Three or four pictures, and all but one go together: fruit, perhaps, or ways to travel. Tap the picture that does not belong. If a picture does go with the others, the game simply says so and waits. After a quiet pause a hint names what the others share, and "Show me" points out the odd one at any time.
howTo: Choose three or four pictures. Three is the simplest.
Look at the pictures together and talk about what most of them have in common.
Tap the picture that does not belong. It gets a gold border and a check mark.
If a picture goes with the others, the game says so and waits. Take your time.
Tap "Show me" whenever you like, then "Another set" for new pictures.
tips: Talk it through out loud: "The apple and the pear are both fruit. What about the bus?"
There is no rush. A hint naming the theme appears after a pause, and you can ignore it.
Any picture is a good start for a chat: a favorite fruit, a bus ride, a rainy day.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: What happens if a picture that belongs is tapped?
faq.a: Nothing unpleasant. There is no buzzer, red cross or shaking. The game names the picture, says it goes with the others, and waits for the next tap.

faq.q: How is the odd picture chosen?
faq.a: The pictures come from everyday themes that need no special knowledge: fruit, animals, flowers, weather, ways to travel, things for a hot drink and things baked in an oven. Each picture belongs to just one theme, and the odd one always comes from a different theme.

faq.q: Hiá, ɛyɛ bɔne, na ehia sɛ wo kyerɛw wo din?
faq.a: Yiw, ɛyɛ bɔne, na wonhia akaunt, kyerɛw din anaa nhyehyɛe biara. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ nhwehwɛmu (browser) so wɔ wo fon, tablet anaa komputa so.

color-match.name: Color match
color-match.seoTitle: Color Match: a Gentle Picture Game
color-match.h1: Color Match: Find the Pictures of One Color
color-match.description: A large color with its name, and four or six pictures. Tap every picture that is that color. No timer, no score, and another color is simply named. Free to play and print.
color-match.short: Find every picture that is the same color as the one shown.
color-match.players: 1 or 2 people, or an adult and a child
color-match.intro: A large patch of color is shown with its name written beside it, and below it are four or six pictures. Tap every picture that is that color: a red apple and a red cup, for example. If a picture is another color, the game simply names it ("The pear is green.") and waits. "Show them" points out the pictures that match at any time, and "Another color" moves on.
howTo: Choose four or six pictures. Four is the simplest.
Look at the color and read its name together.
Tap every picture that is that color. Each one gets a thick border and a check mark.
If a picture is another color, the game says what color it is and waits. Take your time.
Tap "Show them" whenever you like, then "Another color" for a new color.
tips: Say the color out loud, then look around the room: what else is that color?
Use your own words if you like. "Tomato" or "sky" is as good as "red" or "blue".
Pointing works as well as tapping. Sit side by side so you can both see the screen.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: What happens if a picture of another color is tapped?
faq.a: Nothing unpleasant. There is no buzzer, red cross or shaking. The game names the picture and its color, such as "The pear is green.", and waits for the next tap.

faq.q: Is color the only clue?
faq.a: No. The color is shown as a large patch and also written as a word, and every picture is named when it is tapped. Someone who finds a color hard to see can still play by reading the name.

faq.q: Is every picture really that color?
faq.a: The pictures are chosen by hand, and only ones where the main object is plainly one color. Pictures with several colors, such as a kite or a bee, are left out.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Yes. A one-page sheet has four rows. Each row names a color and shows four pictures to point to or circle.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yiw, ɛyɛ bɔne, na wonhia akaunt, kyerɛw din anaa nhyehyɛe biara. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ nhwehwɛmu (browser) so wɔ wo fon, tablet anaa komputa so.

halves-match.name: Halves match
halves-match.seoTitle: Halves Match: a Gentle Picture Game
halves-match.h1: Halves Match: Join the Two Halves of a Picture
halves-match.description: The left halves of two or three pictures on one side, their right halves on the other. Tap a half, then the half that fits it. No timer, no score, and halves that do not fit simply separate. Free to play and print.
halves-match.short: Tap the two halves that fit together to make one picture.
halves-match.players: 1 or 2 people, or an adult and a child
halves-match.intro: Each picture is cut down the middle. The left halves of two or three pictures are in one column and their right halves, in a different order, are in the other. Tap a half on the left, then tap the half on the right that fits it, such as the spout of a kettle and its handle. Halves that fit are joined into a whole picture. Halves that do not fit simply separate again, and the game says so gently. "Show me" joins them all.
howTo: Choose two or three pictures. Two is the simplest.
Look at the left halves together. What do you think each one is part of?
Tap a half on the left, then tap the half on the right that fits it. It also works the other way round.
Halves that fit are joined, with a thick border and a check mark. Halves that do not fit separate again, and you can try another.
Tap "Show me" whenever you like, then "Another set" for new pictures.
tips: Trace the edge of a half with a finger. Where does the drawing reach the middle?
Say what you can see: "That one has a handle." There is no need to name every picture.
Pointing works as well as tapping. Sit side by side so you can both see the screen.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: What happens if two halves do not fit?
faq.a: Nothing unpleasant. There is no buzzer, red cross or shaking. The two halves separate again and the game says, "Those two do not fit together. Try another." Nothing is counted.

faq.q: Are the pictures easy to tell apart?
faq.a: Yes. The pictures are chosen by hand, and two pictures on one board are never from the same group, such as two fruits or two animals. Pictures whose two halves look alike, such as the sun or a rainbow, are left out.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Yiw. Krataa baako so no, afã a ɛwɔ benkum fã no yɛ mfonini abiɛsa, na afã a ɛwɔ nifa fã no wɔ nhyehyɛe foforɔ mu. Twa aburow fi afã biara kɔ afã a ɛfata no so.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ free anaa, na ɛsɛ sɛ meforo akɔ mu?
faq.a: Aane, ɛyɛ free, na ɛnhia akaontɔ, din a wɔka ho, anaa nea wobɛde aba fie. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ web browser so wɔ foon, tablet anaa kɔmpiuta so.

color-by-number.name: Borɔdeɛ de nɔma nkyerɛ
color-by-number.seoTitle: Borɔdeɛ de Nɔma: Ɔkwan Bi a Ɛyɛ Komm, Kɛse-kɛse Ɔhyɛ Ma
color-by-number.h1: Borɔdeɛ de Nɔma: Hyɛ Kwadrat Ma, Borɔdeɛ Biara a Wopɛ
color-by-number.description: Kwadrat kɛse-kɛse a wɔatwa nɔma ma, ne nsɛnkyerɛnne a wɔde borɔdeɛ anan ne wɔn din. Paw borɔdeɛ, then fa kwadrat so de hyɛ ma. Borɔdeɛ biara yɛ, bere anaa nsɛmmisa biara nni hɔ, na bɔtɔn bi ma nea aka no nyinaa ayɛ wɔ nɔma so. Free sɛ wobɛtumi aduru na wɔde ayɛ krataa.
color-by-number.short: Paw borɔdeɛ, then fa kwadrat a wɔatwa nɔma so de hyɛ ma.
color-by-number.intro: Kwadrat kɛse-kɛse a wɔaboa wɔn ho, nea biara wɔ nɔma, ne nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛwɔ soro, a borɔdeɛ anan wɔ mu, biara wɔ ne nɔma ne ne din a wɔakyerɛw. Paw borɔdeɛ fi nsɛnkyerɛnne no mu, then fa kwadrat so de hyɛ ma. Grid no fi 4 by 4 ansa na, na 6 by 6 ne 8 by 8 wɔ hɔ sɛ wopɛ kwadrat dodow. Sɛ kwadrat nyinaa wɔ borɔdeɛ a ɛne nɔma no yɛ no, grid no yɛ mfonini a ɛwɔ krataa no so. Borɔdeɛ foforɔ a wɔde hyɛ kwadrat no yɛ wo ankasa mfonini, na ɔkyerɛ nea ɛnyɛ. "Hyɛ wɔ nɔma so" hyɛ kwadrat a ɛnni hɔ nyinaa ma wo.
howTo: Paw grid no kɛse. 4 by 4 wɔ kwadrat kɛse-kɛse, na ɛyɛ ɛno a ɛyɛ mmerɛw sen biara.
Hwɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛwɔ grid no soro. Borɔdeɛ biara wɔ ne nɔma ne ne din, te sɛ 1 Yellow.
Fa borɔdeɛ bi a ɛwɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne no mu, then kwadrat a wopɛ sɛ wode hyɛ ma so.
Fa borɔdeɛ a ɛwɔ nɔma no so anaa borɔdeɛ foforɔ a wopɛ. Ebia nyinaa yɛ.
Fa "Hyɛ wɔ nɔma so" ma kwadrat a ɛnni hɔ, "Yi nyinaa" sɛ wopɛ sɛ grid no firi ase, anaa "Mfonini foforɔ" sɛ wopɛ mfonini foforɔ.
tips: Tena ɔfã biara mu, na mofa nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn: obi paw borɔdeɛ, obi no nso fa kwadrat so.
Ka ho asɛm wɔ borɔdeɛ no ho: "Mepɛ green no." Ɛnhia sɛ wɔkyerɛ sɛ mfonini no bɛyɛ dɛn.
On a narrow screen the 8 by 8 grid scrolls sideways inside its own box. The squares stay a comfortable size.
Krataa a wɔde ayɛ no nso yɛ adwuma yie, de ikyiri aduru mu wɔ adaka ho.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ bere anaa nkyerɛ ɛbɛn?
faq.a: Dabi. Ɛnni bere, nkontaabu, nkɔso ahodoɔ anaa ɔhwehwɛ. Wobɛtumi asiesie bere biara, na ɛyɛ nkɔso pa sɛ wobɛsiesie wɔ ɛfã mu.

faq.q: Dɛn na ɛbɛba sɛ mede borɔdeɛ a ɛnyɛ nɔma no hyɛ ma?
faq.a: Biribiara remmmɛba, na ɛno na ɛyɛ. Borɔdeɛ biara betumi akɔ kwadrat biara mu, na ɔkyerɛ nea ɛnyɛ. Sɛ kwadrat nyinaa wɔ borɔdeɛ a ɛne nɔma no yɛ no, ɔkyerɛ no ahyɛde, na mfonini a wo ankasa borɔdeɛ no yɛ no, ɛyɛ pa koraa.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ nea wɔn a wɔn ani nnhu borɔdeɛ bi tumi hu borɔdeɛ nsia no ntam?
faq.a: Wɔpaw wɔn sɛ ɛnyɛ den. Borɔdeɛ biara wɔ nɔma, din a wɔakyerɛw ne ne nsɛnkyerɛnne ketewa, enti borɔdeɛ nni ɛ nko ara a wobɛtumi de hu wɔn. Wɔhwehwɛɛ hyɛɛ borɔdeɛ no nyinaa sɛnea ɔhɔ wɔ nnipa a wɔn ani nnhu red-green ne blue-yellow no nso, na wɔn nso yɛ ɔhɔ kɛse-ketewa. Obiara a ne ani nnhu borɔdeɛ bi nnsɔ hwɛ bi, enti sɛ borɔdeɛ abien hwɛ te sɛ ɛte saa a, ka kyerɛ yɛn.

faq.q: Kwadrat no kɛse sen sɛ ɛbɛboa nnipa a wɔn nsa bɔ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn anaa screen ketewa?
faq.a: Kwadrat biara yɛ pixel 48 anaa sen saa, na 56 wɔ grid 4 by 4 no so. Sɛ grid no yɛ kɛse sen screen no, ɛbɛtu kɔ ɔfã foforɔ wɔ ne ankasa adan mu, na ɛnkyekyɛ kwadrat no.

faq.q: Wɔwɔ krataa so version bi anaa?
faq.a: Aane. Krataa baako so no wɔ grid a wɔatwa nɔma so ne borɔdeɛ anan a wɔn din wɔ ho. Hyɛ kwadrat biara de pensil a ɛyɛ nɔma no borɔdeɛ anaa borɔdeɛ foforɔ a wopɛ.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ free anaa, na ɛsɛ sɛ meforo akɔ mu?
faq.a: Aane, ɛyɛ free, na ɛnhia akaontɔ, din a wɔka ho, anaa nea wobɛde aba fie. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ web browser so wɔ foon, tablet anaa kɔmpiuta so.

pattern-maker.name: Ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ nhyehyɛe
pattern-maker.seoTitle: Ɔkwan a Wɔfa so Yɛ Nhyehyɛe: Yɛ Ɔfasu Ketewa, Hyɛ Nhyehyɛe
pattern-maker.h1: Ɔkwan a Wɔfa so Yɛ Nhyehyɛe: Yɛ Ɔfasu, Hwɛ sɛ Ɛsan Ba
pattern-maker.description: Sesa kwadrat a ɛwɔ ɔfasu ketewa baako mu, na hwɛ sɛnea ɛsan ba ɛfiri ase ne nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ ne akyi, wɔ borɔdeɛ anan a wɔn biara wɔ din ne ɔkwan. Bere anaa nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn biara nni hɔ. Free sɛ wobɛtumi aduru na wɔde ayɛ krataa.
pattern-maker.short: Sesa kwadrat a ɛwɔ ɔfasu ketewa mu, na hwɛ sɛnea ɛsan ba ɛyɛ nhyehyɛe.
pattern-maker.intro: Ɔfasu ketewa a wɔayɛ 3 by 3 kwadrat, anaa 4 by 4 sɛ wopɛ, ne "wo nhyehyɛe" a ɛwɔ akyi: ɔfasu no ankasa a wɔsan de ayɛ ɔfã bi. Fa kwadrat bi, na ɛsesa kɔ borɔdeɛ anan a ɛdi hɔ no so ɛbɛyɛ foforɔ. Nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ akyi no sesa ntɛmntɛm. Nhyehyɛe pa biara nni hɔ, na wɔnsie biribiara anaa wɔnsoma biribiara. "Dwene me nhyehyɛe" de nhyehyɛe no kɔ krataa baako so, sɛ wopɛ sɛ wobɛkora, wɔde hyɛ ma, anaa wɔde ma obi.
howTo: Hwɛ ɔfasu no ne wo nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ akyi. Ɛyɛ ɔfasu koro no, a wɔsan de ayɛ.
Fa kwadrat bi. Ɛbɛsesa kɔ borɔdeɛ a ɛdi hɔ, a ɛwɔ borɔdeɛ anan a ɛwɔ soro no mu.
Fa kwadrat so kɔsi sɛ nhyehyɛe no ayɛ sɛnea wopɛ. Nhyehyɛe biara yɛ pa.
Fa "Fa me sɛ ɛbɛyɛ" ma ɔfasu foforɔ, anaa "Fi ase bio" ma ɔfasu a ɛnni hɔ. "San ma ɛkɔ hɔ" san de ɔfasu a waniwa no ba.
Fa "Dwene me nhyehyɛe" sɛ wopɛ sɛ ɛba krataa so, anaa fa "Ahodwo" de gyae.
tips: Ntena ne obi nkyɛn, na mo bom yɛ adwuma: obi bi bɔ sikwa baako, na afoforɔ ka nea ɔhwɛ.
Ka nea wohwɛ ho asɛm: “Ɛte sɛ ahabammono.” Ɛnhia sɛ wobɔ hɔ din biara.
Sɔ dwene yi wɔ kɔla abien nkyɛn hwɛ, afei sɔ bio wɔ kɔla anan nkyɛn.
Sɛ ɛwɔ pampa so a, wobetumi de pensel ayɛ kɔla, atwa mu nkyɛnkyɛn ma kaad, anaa de ahyɛ kyɛfa ketewa bi mu.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ bere a wobɛhwɛ anaa nkontaabu ana?
faq.a: Dabi. Ɛnni bere, nkontaabu, nkɔso kontaa anaa ɔhaw. Wobetumi agyae bere biara, na sɛ wogyae wɔ fam a, ɛyɛ ɔkwan pa a wɔfa so awie adwuma no.

faq.q: Wɔsie anaa wɔsoma biribi a mayɛ no ana?
faq.a: Dabi. Wo nhyehyɛe no tena kratafa yi nko ara. Wɔnsie, wɔnsoma anaa wɔnkan, na sɛ woto kratafa no a, ɛkɔ. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wobɛkora nhyehyɛe no a, tɔ so (print).

faq.q: Dɛn na ɛbɛyɛ sɛ mebɔ sikwa a ɛnyɛ yiye, anaa mayi nhyehyɛe no fi ase ankasa?
faq.a: Sikwa a ɛnyɛ yiye nni hɔ: fa ankɔ so tɔ bio de kɔ kɔla a edi hɔ. Wɔ “Fi ase foforɔ” anaa “Hwɛ biribi foforɔ” akyi, “Sane so” de nhyehyɛe a wowɔ ansa no san ba.

faq.q: Nnipa a wɔnhu kɔla yiye no betumi asiesie kɔla nnan no ntam ana?
faq.a: Wɔapaw wɔn sɛ wɔbɛyɛ saa. Kɔla biara nso wɔ din a wɔakyerɛw, ne ntɛnteɛ kɔkɔɔ a ɛyɛ ketewa wɔ sikwa biara mu, enti kɔla nkaa nkwan koraa nkyerɛ sɛ nnipa betumi ahu wɔn ntam. Wɔahwɛ kɔla yi wɔ nhwɛso a ɛda kɔla hu nsɛm ahorow ho so. Nnipa a wɔwɔ kɔla hu nsɛm nkyɛn nnyaa wɔnsɔ hwɛ, enti sɛ mohu sɛ nkyɛn baanu no ntam nyɛ mmoɔ a, kyerɛ yɛn.

faq.q: Sikwa no kɛse sɛ wɔbɛtumi ahyɛ ntsɛ a ɛwɔ ɔdwiwɔ mu anaa screen ketewa mu ana?
faq.a: Sikwa biara yɛ pixel 56 anaa ɛboro saa wɔ mmɔnka so. Sɛ nhyehyɛe no yɛ kɛse sen screen no a, ɛnyɛ sikwa no ketewa, na ɛtu kɔ fam wɔ ne bokɔ mu.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ pampa so kwan bi ana?
faq.a: Aane. “Tɔ me nhyehyɛe” de nhyehyɛe a woyɛe no bɛtɔ kratafa baako so, kɔla nnan ne wɔn din nso wɔ mu. Ɛyɛ yie wɔ tuntum ne fitaa mu, efisɛ kɔla biara wɔ ne ntɛnteɛ ankasa.

faq.q: Ɛnhia sika ana, na ɛsɛ sɛ mekyerɛw din mu?
faq.a: Aane, ɛnhia sika, na ɛnhia akontaa, akyerɛw din anaa nsie biribi. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ web browser wɔ foon, tablet anaa komputa so.

drawing-duet.name: Nhwɛso mmienu
drawing-duet.seoTitle: Nhwɛso Mmienu: Nnipa Mmienu, Nhwɛso Baako
drawing-duet.h1: Nhwɛso Mmienu: Nnipa Mmienu, Kratafa Baako
drawing-duet.description: Nnipa baanu bɛsan de ntoma nsoma wɔ kanvas baako so, na obiara de ne kɔla. Obini nni nkontaabu na obi nni nnwonwa, na wobetumi asie anaa atɔ nhwɛso no. Ɛnhia sika, na ɛnhia akontaa.
drawing-duet.short: Fa wo nkyɛn obi a ɔwɔ wo nkyɛn bɛyɛ nhwɛso baako.
drawing-duet.intro: Kanvas baako, nnipa mmienu. Mo mu biara paw kɔla, na kɔla biara wɔ ne din a wɔakyerɛw. Mo bɛsan: de ntoma baako anaa nhwɛso baako tɔ, afei de peni no kɔ afoforɔ nkyɛn. Mo mu biara betumi apow bere biara. Nhwɛso pa biara nni hɔ, na nkontaabu nni hɔ. Sɛ wopɛ nhwɛso no a, sie no wɔ wo ahodoɔ so, anaa tɔ pampa mu: kratafa baako, peni mmienu.
howTo: Mo mu biara paw kɔla. Banner no kyerɛ nea ɔbɛyɛ bere no, na ɛka ɔfã no kɔla din.
De nsa, mouse anaa peni tɔ ntoma baako anaa nhwɛso baako. Anaa fa arrow keys ne Space de tɔ ntoma a wɔnni pointer.
Sɛ woayɛ no, tɔ “Fa peni kɔ afoforɔ nkyɛn”. Mo mu biara betumi asan bere biara.
Tɔ “Yi me ntoma a ɛda so no” de yi ntoma a ɛda so wɔ nea ɔbɛyɛ bere no nhwɛso mu.
Tɔ “Sie nhwɛso” de nhwɛso file bi yɛ wo ahodoɔ yi so, anaa “Tɔ pampa mu” de kratafa baako ne peni mmienu.
tips: Tena ne obi nkyɛn, na ka nsɛm bere a moreyɛ nhwɛso no: “Mɛde owia bi aka mpɔtam no mu.”
Fi ase de bɔbɔ, ntoma anaa nhwɛso kwaa, na ma afoforɔ no nkɔ so.
Obiara nhia sɛ ɔbɛtɔ biribi nhwɛso. Ntoma nhyehyɛe nso yɛ pa koro sɛ nhwɛso kɛse biara.
Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wogyae a, tɔ “Awie ɛnnɛ”. Wo nhwɛso no ntena hɔ wo akɔ kratafa no so a, gye sɛ wosie no.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ obi a ɔdi nkonim anaa nkontaabu ana?
faq.a: Dabi. Ɛnni obi a ɔdi nkonim, nkontaabu, bere anaa bere a yɛaka. Nhwɛso pa biara nni hɔ, na biribiara nnyɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ anaa nsusuw.

faq.q: Wɔsie nhwɛso no anaa wɔsoma no ana?
faq.a: Dabi, biribiara nsoma kɔ baabi biara. Nhwɛso no tena kratafa yi so kɔsi sɛ woto no. Sɛ wotɔ “Sie nhwɛso” a, wɔbɛyɛ file wɔ wo ahodoɔ so ma wo de bɛtow. Wɔnnkɔ so biribiara.

faq.q: Metumi ayi ntoma bi san ana?
faq.a: Aane. “Yi me ntoma a ɛda so no” yi ntoma foforɔ a ɔbɛyɛ ne bere no nea ɛda so. “Fi ase foforɔ” pam kratafa no, na “Sane so” san de ntoma no ba, nea ɛyɛ baako ara.

faq.q: Metumi de nni mouse anaa touch screen so yɛ saa adwuma yi ana?
faq.a: Aane. Sɛ nhwɛso no reyɛ adwuma a, arrow keys de peni tuo no kɔ, na Space key de peni no si fam anaa ɔsan fi fam. Screen no kyerɛ “Peni si fam” anaa “Peni fi fam” bere biara.

faq.q: Kɔla hɛn na ɛyɛ, na nnipa a wɔnhu kɔla yiye betumi ahu wɔn ntam ana?
faq.a: Yɛlo, orenj, griin ne pɔpul, kɔla nnan a yɛde di yɛn nhwɛso akwan afoforɔ mu no. Kɔla biara wɔ din a wɔakyerɛw, na din no da bere no akyi. Wɔhwɛɛ kɔla yi wɔ nhwɛso a ɛda kɔla hu nsɛm a ɛba nnipa mu no so, nanso obi a ɔwɔ kɔla hu nsɛm nkyɛn nnyaa ɔnsɔ hwɛ.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ pampa so kwan bi ana?
faq.a: Aane. “Tɔ pampa mu” de kratafa baako a mmara wɔ so ne nkɔ kɛse a ɛyɛ fitaa a wɔbɛtoa so bɛyɛ nhwɛso no bɔ mu, ma nnipa mmienu ne peni mmienu. Ɛyɛ yie wɔ tuntum ne fitaa mu.

faq.q: Ɛnhia sika ana, na ɛsɛ sɛ mekyerɛw din mu?
faq.a: Ja, dwene no yɛ free, na ɛnhia account, sign-up anaa download. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ web browser a wɔde fon, tablet anaa kɔmputa so.

build-together.name: Build together
build-together.seoTitle: Build Together: Two People Build One Pattern
build-together.h1: Build Together: Two People, One Grid
build-together.description: Two people take turns to put a piece in a shared grid until it is full, each with a color of their own that has a name and a shape. Nobody wins, and there is no timer or score. Free to play and print.
build-together.short: Take turns with someone beside you to fill one shared grid.
build-together.intro: A shared grid of 4 by 4 places, or 3 by 3 if you like. Each of you picks a color, and each color has its own written name and shape. You take turns: on your turn, tap an empty place to put your piece there. When every place has a piece, the picture is built together. There is no winner, because you make it as a pair, and nothing is saved or sent. "Print the grid" puts an empty grid on one page so you can build with two pencils.
howTo: Obiara biara paw ne kɔlɔr. Kɔlɔr a obi a ɔwɔ no no, wɔde "In use" aka.
Ɔpanin no na ɔkɔ ne kwan. Krataa no kyerɛ nea ɔrehyɛ ɔkwan no ne nea ne kɔlɔr yɛ ne no.
Tɔ nkyɛn a ɛnni kɔlɔr no biara so de wo kɔlɔr no nkɔ hɔ. Ɔkwan no kɔ akyɛ no a ɔnni ho.
Sɛ wopɛ sɛ w�remfa kɔlɔr biara nkɔ hɔ a, tɔ "Pass". Obiara bɛtumi ayɛ saa bere biara.
Sɛ kɔlɔr biara da nkyɛn a, woabɔ mfonini no wɔ ho ne mu. Tɔ "Start again" sɛ wopɛ sɛ wobɔ foforo, anaa tɔ Rest sɛ wopɛ sɛ wɔgyae.
tips: Fa nkyɛn ɛfa nkyɛn sɛdeɛ mo nyinaa bɛhunu na mo nyinaa atumi ato krataa no so. Kasa bere a moreyɛ adwuma: "Mʼakɔ de me kɔlɔr bɛfa wo ho."
Sɛ wopɛ a, yɛ mfonini bi, mmɛnkɔnkɔn, ɔkaneka ntɛm, anaa ɔfa a wɔde ntɛm, anaa kɔ nkyɛn biara a wopɛ. Nea ɔnyɛ ne ho yɛ.
Ɔba anaa obi a ɔyɛ no ntɛm no bɛtumi apass daa sɛdeɛ ɔpɛ. Ɛnyɛ no hwee, mfonini no bɛbɔ ho ka.
Wɔ krataa so no, obiara de ne ho pɛnsɛl de bɔ ne ho ntoma wɔ mpɔnsɛ a enni mu no mu.

faq.q: Is there a winner, a timer or a score?
faq.a: Dabi. Obiara nni nkonyaa, efisɛ mo nyinaa boa mfonini baako. Ɛnni bere, mmuae, nsɛm a wɔdi mu anaa nkɔnkɔm. Wobetumi agyae bere biara, na sɛ wogyae ɔfã mu nso yɛ adwuma a ɛyɛ.

faq.q: Is anything we make saved or sent?
faq.a: Dabi. Kratafa no ka ho wɔ saa ntawntawa yi nko ara. Wɔnkora so, wɔnnkɔ soro, na wɔnnkan ho, na ɛbɛwere bere a wotwe saa ntawntawa no. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wobɛkora so a, bɔ kratafa no mfonini na bɔ wɔ krataa so.

faq.q: What if I put a piece in the wrong place?
faq.a: Ɛnni beaebi a ɛnteɛ. Tɔ "Take back the last piece" na ɔkwan no san kɔ wo nkyɛn. Wobetumi asan de ɔkwan biara ato hɔ, na wobetumi asan asi pass nso.

faq.q: Can the four colors be told apart by people with color-blindness?
faq.a: Wɔpaw wɔn ɛnam saa nti. Kɔlɔr biara wɔ ne din a wɔakyerɛw so ne ne ntɛm kakra wɔ ɔkwan biara mu, enti kɔlɔr nko ara nyinaa nni ho. Wɔsɔɔ kɔlɔr anan no hwɛ wɔ nhwehwɛmu a ɛfa kɔlɔr a obi nhu yiye red-green ne blue-yellow ho. Obi a ɔnhu kɔlɔr yiye no nnyaa nsɔ wɔn hwɛ, enti kɔ kyerɛ yɛn sɛ mmienu bɛn sɛ wɔte sɛ nʼani mu.

faq.q: Are the places big enough for a tremor or a small screen?
faq.a: Beaebi biara yɛ piksɛl 56 bɔsɛ. Sɛ krataa no yɛ kɛse sen krataa no mu a, ɛbɛtwa akyi ne nkyɛn wɔ ne ho mu, na ɛremma beaebi no nketewa.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Dabi. "Print the grid" bɔ kratafa baako so ntɛm a ɛnni ade ne kɔlɔr abien ne wɔn din, na wobɔ ho ntoma de pɛnsɛl abien. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ tintin ne fitaa mu, efisɛ kɔlɔr biara wɔ ne ntɛm.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Dabi, ɛyɛ free, na ɛnhia account, sign-up anaa download. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ web browser a wɔde fon, tablet anaa kɔmputa so.

seated-toss.name: Seated toss tally
seated-toss.seoTitle: Seated Toss Tally: a Bean-Bag Game for Two
seated-toss.h1: Seated Toss Tally: Toss Together at a Table
seated-toss.description: Two people at a table take turns tossing a soft bean bag into a big target and keep the tally on paper. Nothing is timed or scored. Free to print.
seated-toss.short: Take turns tossing a bean bag at a big target, with the tally on paper.
seated-toss.intro: A calm tossing game for two people sitting at a table. You lay a printed target on the table and take turns tossing a soft bean bag, or a rolled-up sock, so that it lands on the rings. Each of you keeps a tally by ticking boxes on paper, and you look at the ticks together when you stop. Nothing is timed, nothing is added up on screen, and nothing is saved or sent. Please read the safety notes first: small fillings are a choking hazard.
howTo: Kenkan akwan a ɛfa ahobammɔ ho. Yi bean bag a ɔwɔ kasa a wɔadi so mu, anaa de sɔkɔ a ɛyɛ teasefo ntoto mu.
Tɔ "Print the target and tally sheet" na de krataa no ato tabɔn no so ntɛm wɔ mo mu.
Tena ase yiye, mo baako wɔ kɔnkɔn biara so, na mo nyinaa de bɛtoto yɛn-yɛn. Obiara bɛtumi apass.
Sɛ toto bi kɔ ahama mu a, de ntɛm bɔ wo kɔlɔm mu, wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfa ahama no so.
Sɛ moagyae a, mo nyinaa hwɛ ntɛm no wɔ ho, anaa tɔ Rest sɛ wopɛ sɛ wɔgyae.
tips: Sit close enough that a gentle underhand toss reaches the target without any stretching.
Talk about the toss, not the result: "Ee yɛ toss a ɛyɛ dɛ." Everyone cheers for every toss.
A rolled-up sock is light and easy to hold with a weak grip. Rest an arm on the table between turns.
If someone would rather watch, they can be the one who ticks the boxes.

faq.q: Wɔwɔ bere ankɔsɛ anaa nsɛm ahodoɔ ho nhwɛso?
faq.a: Dabi. Biribi nni ho ma bere, nsɛm ahodoɔ, ntoatoa anaa ɔhwere. Wubetumi agyae bere biara, na agyaeɛ ɛfiri ɛda mfinimfini mu yɛ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ yiye de awie adwuma no.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ ahobammɔ sɛ wobɛtoa mpɔtam ahyɛ ase?
faq.a: Ɛtumi yɛ saa, nanso ɛsɛ sɛ wodi ho ban. Fa apɔwa a wɔadi kɔnkɔn ano a wɔadeeɛ anaa sɔkɔ a wɔapenee, na nni nsuo yɛ nkɔm, bɛnkyene anaa ahode ketewa a ɛbɛyɛ ɔhaw ma mmofra ketewa ne obiara a ɔde nneɛma to ne ano. Tena fɛ, toa nkɔm kɔ abɔdeɛ no so, na mfa anka wo ahoma nkɔ anwannwadeɛ so, na ma ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa a ɔbɛboa wo nka wo nkyɛn.

faq.q: Ɛbɛyɛ ɔhwɛ anaa wɔbɛkyerɛ nsɛm wɔ krataa no so?
faq.a: Dabi. Nkontaabu no wɔ krataa so nko, wɔ mpɔn a mo ankasa mo ara bɛtwa ntɛm so. Nsɛntwe no nkɔ nkontaabu anaa bere biara, na wɔnsie wɔ nkɔm mu anaa wɔnsoma.

faq.q: Dɛn na ɛbɛyɛ sɛ obiara ntumi nto anaa mpɔtam no nsɛe krataa no akyi?
faq.a: Obiara tumi gyae, na mpɔtam a ɛsɛe krataa no akyi no wɔbɛhwehwɛ no ma ɛbɛyɛ ɔkwan no. Wɔngyina ho nkontaabu.

faq.q: Dɛn na ɛwɔ krataa a wɔabɔ no so?
faq.a: Krataa baako: abɔdeɛ kɛseɛ a ne mpɔn abien a wɔatwa ntoma se Nkyɛn, Mfimfini ne Akyirikyiri, ne akwan a ɛwɔ ɔkwan biara ma obiara ne nkɔ ketewa a wɔbɛtwa ma ɔkwan biara, ne asɛm kakra a ɛka ahobammɔ ho. Wɔakyerɛw din no wɔ mpɔn no so, enti ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ tuntum ne fɛfɛ.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ bebree na ɛsɛ sɛ metumi a me ankasa me ho?
faq.a: Ɛyɛ, ɛnyɛ bebree, na nkyerɛwde ho akontaabu, nkɔsoɔ anaa nnwuma biara nhia. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ web browser wɔ foon, tablet anaa komputa so.

seasonal-pack.name: Seasonal puzzle pack
seasonal-pack.seoTitle: Seasonal Puzzle Pack: Printable Paper Puzzles
seasonal-pack.h1: Seasonal Puzzle Pack: Three Paper Puzzles for Each Month
seasonal-pack.description: Three small printable puzzles for any month of the year: match the pairs, circle the one that is different, and color a picture in. The page opens on this month, or choose another, or take a rest day. Free to print.
seasonal-pack.short: Three printable puzzles for the month you choose, or a rest day.
seasonal-pack.players: All ages, solo or side by side
seasonal-pack.intro: Choose a month, and the page shows three small paper puzzles drawn from that month's pictures: two rows to join with lines, a row of four to circle the one that is different, and a picture to color in. The page opens on the current month of your device. You print one page, then do one, two or all three, at your own pace. Choose "Today is a rest day" instead and there is nothing to do.
howTo: Choose a month, or choose "Today is a rest day".
Look at the three puzzles, then tap "Print this month's pack".
Do one, two or all three, at your own pace.
Join the matching pictures with a line, circle the one that is different, and color the large picture in.
Stop whenever you like. A rest day is a good day too.
tips: Start with the puzzle that feels easiest today. One is enough.
Say the name of each picture aloud, if that helps.
Use crayons or pencils. Any colors are fine.
Keep the page for next time, or let it go.

faq.q: Wɔwɔ bere ankɔsɛ anaa nsɛm ahodoɔ ho nhwɛso?
faq.a: Dabi. Biribi nni ho ma bere, nsɛm ahodoɔ, ntoatoa anaa ɔhwere. Wubetumi agyae bere biara, na agyaeɛ ɛfiri ɛda mfinimfini mu yɛ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ yiye de awie adwuma no.

faq.q: Krataa no te sɛ ɛberɛ bɛn na yɛ no?
faq.a: Dabi. Wo ara na wopɛ bere. Krataa no nhwɛ da anaa wo beaeɛ.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ nsɛm ahodoɔ anaa nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware?
faq.a: Dabi. Wɔnhwɛ bere, nsɛm ahodoɔ anaa nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware wɔ hɔ wɔ krataa so, na wɔnkyerɛ mmuae biara. Mpɔtam biara yɛ mfonini a wɔhwɛ, a wɔtwa ntoma, a wɔwie anaa a wɔde nsuo ho.

faq.q: Dɛn na ɛbɛyɛ sɛ obiara ammpɛ mpɔtam nnɛ?
faq.a: Paw "Ɛnnɛ yɛ ɔdwodwoɔ da". Krataa no bɛkyerɛ nsɛm kakra a ɛyɛ dwodwoɔ, na biribi nni ho a wobɛbɔ anaa wobɛyɛ.

faq.q: Dɛn na ɛwɔ krataa a wɔabɔ no so?
faq.a: Krataa baako ma bere a woapaw: ne mpɔtam abiɛsa, biara wɔ ne ɔkwan a wɔbɛyɛ no ketewa, ne asɛm a ɛka sɛ wubetumi ayɛ baako, abien anaa nyinaa.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ bebree na ɛsɛ sɛ metumi a me ankasa me ho?
faq.a: Ɛyɛ, ɛnyɛ bebree, na nkyerɛwde ho akontaabu, nkɔsoɔ anaa nnwuma biara nhia. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ web browser wɔ foon, tablet anaa komputa so.

decorate-a-card.name: Decorate a card together
decorate-a-card.seoTitle: Decorate a Card Together: a Printable Greeting Card
decorate-a-card.h1: Decorate a Card Together: Make One for Someone
decorate-a-card.description: Two people decorate a printed greeting card for a birthday, a thank you or just because, then write a message on the back together. Crayons or pens only. No timer or score. Free to print.
decorate-a-card.short: Decorate a printed greeting card together.
decorate-a-card.intro: A quiet making game for two people sitting side by side. You print one sheet, which folds in half to make a card. Choose an occasion, such as a birthday or a thank you, and decorate the front around its words. Then write a message on the back, together or one person writing what the other says. Use crayons, colored pencils or felt-tip pens. There is no right card, and nothing is timed, scored or sent.
howTo: Pick an occasion, then tap "Print the card".
Fold the sheet in half along the dotted line, so the front is on the outside.
One person decorates the front and the other decorates the back, or you take turns on one side.
Write a message together. One person can write while the other says the words.
Stop whenever you like. A simple card is just as good as a detailed one.
tips: Start with the words on the front, then add leaves, stars or dots around them, one at a time.
If someone would rather not draw, they can choose the colours or write the message.
Say what you like about the other person's marks, rather than whether they are good.
Keep the card somewhere it can be given, or simply keep it on the table for now.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Do we need glue, scissors or stickers?
faq.a: No. Crayons, coloured pencils or felt-tip pens are enough. Nothing needs cutting, gluing or sticking.

faq.q: Can we make a card for an occasion that is not on the list?
faq.a: Choose "Just because" and write your own words on the front, or simply decorate the card with no occasion at all.

faq.q: Is anything counted, judged or saved on the screen?
faq.a: No. The page only shows the card and the steps. Nothing is ranked, scored or saved, and there is no right card.

faq.q: What is on the printed sheet?
faq.a: One page: a card folded in half, with the occasion words and a simple frame on the front, and lines for a message and a From line on the back. The rules for two people are printed along the bottom.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

find-together.name: Find together
find-together.seoTitle: Find Together: Two People Find the Pairs
find-together.h1: Find Together: Two People, One Team
find-together.description: Two people share one screen and take turns turning over two picture cards to look for a pair. Pairs are found together and counted on one shared tally. Free to play, with no timer or score.
find-together.short: Take turns with someone beside you to find the picture pairs.
find-together.intro: The cards start with their pictures showing, or you can lay them face down. On your turn you turn over two cards. If they are a pair, you have found it together and the turn passes. If they are different, they stay face up until you press "Turn them back", so you can both look. Pass at any time. The tally at the top only goes up: the pairs you have found together.
howTo: Choose how many cards to use. Six cards, three pairs, is a calm place to start.
The screen says whose turn it is, with a circle for the first person and a square for the second.
Turn over two cards, one after the other. If they match, the pair is found together.
If they are different, press "Turn them back" when you are both ready. The turn then passes.
Either of you may press "Pass" at any time. Tap "Start again" for new cards, or tap Rest to stop.
tips: Sit side by side and name the pictures out loud together: "A teacup. Do you take milk in your tea?"
Let the person you care for do the tapping, even if it takes a while. Point rather than tap for them.
Choose "Cards face down" if you both enjoy turning cards over to find the pictures.
A person who tires easily can pass as often as they like. The pairs are still found together.

faq.q: Is there a winner, a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no winner, because you find the pairs as a team. There is no clock, no score and no count of misses. The tally only counts the pairs you have found together, and you can stop at any moment.

faq.q: Do we have to remember where the pictures are?
faq.a: No. The game starts with every picture in view. With the cards face down, you can ask each other what you saw, or simply turn them over again.

faq.q: What happens when two cards are different?
faq.a: They stay face up, so you can both look at them, for as long as you need. Nothing turns them back by itself. When you are ready, press "Turn them back" and the turn passes to the other person.

faq.q: Is anything we play saved or sent?
faq.a: No. The cards stay on this page only. Nothing is saved, uploaded or counted, and it is gone when you close the page.

faq.q: Are the cards big enough for a tremor or a small screen?
faq.a: Every card is at least 64 pixels across and is as large as the screen allows. Keyboard and screen reader users hear each card by its place and its picture.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

story-dice.name: Story dice
story-dice.seoTitle: Story Dice: a Picture Storytelling Game
story-dice.h1: Story Dice: Tell a Story with Pictures
story-dice.description: Three or four picture dice to tell a story with, in any order. No reading, no right answer, no timer and no score. Roll again, or pass. Free to play and print.
story-dice.short: Roll picture dice and tell a story together, in any order.
story-dice.players: 2 or more people, or an adult and a child
story-dice.intro: Wɔde mfonini anan anaa mmiensa besi hɔ, te sɛ dice. Wɔ hɔ bi, fa biribi a ɛbɛka mfonini no ho ma yɛ asɛm, wɔ sɛdeɛ ɔpɛ mu. Asɛm no tumi yɛ asɛm baako anaa nkyɛmu, ɛtumi ayɛ anigye anaa ɛyɛ nokware. Asɛm pa biara nni hɔ, na obi nhia sɛ ɔbɛka din anaa ɔbɛkae biribi. Fa "Yi bio" ma mfonini foforo, na obiara tumi gyae.
howTo: Fa dice mmiensa anaa anan. Mmiensa yɛ kwan a ɛyɛ mmerɛw sen biara.
Hwɛ mfonini no ne wo ho nyinaa. Tɔ mfonini bi sɛ wopɛ sɛ wofi ase wɔ so.
Momfa mmuae asɛm a ɛde mfonini no bɛka no, wɔ sɛdeɛ ɔpɛ mu. Nkyɛmu baako ara ɛboro.
Obiara tumi gyae. Tɔ "Gyae", na obi a ɔdi hɔ bɛfi ase.
Tɔ "Yi bio" ma mfonini foforo bere biara a wopɛ, anaa tɔ "Ɔhome" de aba ase.
tips: Bisa ɔbisa sɛ, mmfa mmuae nhwɛ: "Ɛhe na agyinaten no bɛkɔ?"
Ka asɛm a obi a ɛdi kan no aka ho, mma ɔsesa. Asɛm biara yɛ.
Asɛm bi tumi fi nkae a ɛyɛ nokware ho. Mfonini bi yɛ fi pa ma ɛfi ase.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ bere a wɔbɛhwɛ anaa nkontaabu?
faq.a: Dabi. Ɛnni awɔw, nkontaabu, anaa ɔhwɛ aba a wɔde bɛkyerɛ. Wobetumi agyae bere biara, na ɛyɛ pa sɛ wɔagyae wɔ mfinimfini.

faq.q: Ɛhia sɛ meka anaa mekae mfonini no din?
faq.a: Dabi. Kwan no yɛ ma mfonini no nko ara. Obi tumi kyerɛ, kyerɛkyerɛ anaa ka nea mfonini no kae ma no. Wɔnhia obi sɛ ɔka din anaa ɔkae biribi.

faq.q: Dɛn sɛ obi remmɔ ne bere?
faq.a: Obi tumi gyae bere biara a, ɛnhia sɛ ɔka nsɛm biara. Kwan no bɛtena hɔ de ma obi a ɛdi hɔ no bɛfi ase, anaa wɔbɛyi bio.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ paper version?
faq.a: Dabi. Krataa baako a ɛwɔ mfonini du ne nsia a ɛyɛ nea ɛvɛ, wɔ nkyɛn anan mu. Fa nkyɛn biara, anaa tew mfonini no, na fa bi a ɛbɛba.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ free anaa ehia sɛ mema din?
faq.a: Dabi, ɛyɛ free, na ɛnhia account, din a wode kyerɛ anaa download. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ web browser wɔ foone, tablet anaa komputa so.

word-and-picture-pairs.name: Nsɛm ne mfonini a ɛfa ho
word-and-picture-pairs.seoTitle: Nsɛm ne Mfonini Mmoa: Fa Nsɛm Ma Mfonini
word-and-picture-pairs.h1: Nsɛm ne Mfonini Mmoa: Fa Nsɛm no Ma Mfonini
word-and-picture-pairs.description: Fa English nsɛm ma wɔn mfonini, na tie nsɛm biara a wɔkenkan. Mfonini no hyɛ hɔ, na bere, nkontaabu anaa aba nni hɔ. Ɛyɛ free a wɔtumi de ayɛ ne print.
word-and-picture-pairs.short: Fa nsɛm biara ma ne mfonini, na tie a wɔkenkan.
word-and-picture-pairs.players: Obi baako, anaa abusua a wɔrehyɛ ho ho
word-and-picture-pairs.intro: Wɔda mfonini anan anaa nsia besi hɔ, na nsɛm a ɛwɔ English mu no wɔ nkyekyɛmu foforo. Tɔ nsɛm, na tɔ ne mfonini; anaa tɔ mfonini na tɔ ne nsɛm. Nsɛm ne mfonini a ɛtoa so no kɔ hyɛ nkɔ, na wɔde "Ɛtoa so" di adanse. Tɔ "Kenkan" ahyɛ nsɛm biara nkyɛn tie no. Bere biara nni hɔ, nkontaabu nni hɔ, na tɔ a ɛnyɛ pɛ no nso ɛsa ara.
howTo: Fa mfonini anan anaa nsia. Anan yɛ kwan a ɛyɛ mmerɛw sen biara.
Tɔ nsɛm, na tɔ mfonini a ɛka ho. Anaa tɔ mfonini kan, na tɔ ne nsɛm.
Nsɛm ne mfonini a ɛtoa so no kɔ hyɛ nkɔ. Tɔ a ɛnyɛ pɛ no ara yera, enti sɔ hwɛ bio.
Tɔ "Kenkan" ahyɛ nsɛm biara nkyɛn tie no, sɛ wo device tumi kenkan nsɛm.
Tɔ "Mfonini foforo" ma nhyehyɛe foforo, anaa "Fi ase bio" de nsɛm ne mfonini nyinaa asiesie. "San de no ba mu" de nkitahodie a etwa to no ba.
tips: Ka nsɛm no ho ka ntam kan a wobɛtoa mfonini no so, na kasa ho nsɛm wɔ mfonini no ho.
Abusua bɛtumi asesa. Obiara tumi fa nsɛm anaa mfonini baako ma bere biara.
Fa nsɛm a wunim kan, na gyae afoforo ma akyire.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ bere a wɔbɛhwɛ anaa nkontaabu?
faq.a: Dabi. Ɛnni awɔw, nkontaabu, anaa ɔhwɛ aba a wɔde bɛkyerɛ. Wobetumi agyae bere biara, na ɛyɛ pa sɛ wɔagyae wɔ mfinimfini.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ ma mmofra anaa?
faq.a: Ɛyɛ ma mmarima ne mmaa a wɔrehwehwɛ anaa wɔresesa English nsɛm, ne abusua a wɔrehyɛ ho ho. Wɔnkyerɛw no ma mmofra.

faq.q: Dɛn sɛ me device ntumi nkenkan nsɛm?
faq.a: Bɔtɔn "Kenkan" de browser a ɛwɔ hɔ no nkenkan. Sɛ browser no ntumi nka a, bɔtɔn no nni hɔ, na kwan no yɛ adwuma a ɛnni no.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ paper version?
faq.a: Dabi. Krataa baako a ɛwɔ mfonini nsia ne wɔn nsɛm nsia, a wobɛtew anaa wode tɔ ɔkwan bi.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ free anaa ehia sɛ mema din?
faq.a: Dabi, ɛyɛ free, na ɛnhia account, din a wode kyerɛ anaa download. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ web browser wɔ foone, tablet anaa komputa so.

sort-together.name: Hyehyɛ bom
sort-together.seoTitle: Sorting Game: Hyehyɛ Ne Ho Ma Mmarima ne Mmaa
sort-together.description: Tɔ mfonini, na tɔ basket a ɛfata: kuruwa anaa turo, aba anaa mmoa. Ɛyɛ sorting game a ɛyɛ dɛ, ɛyɛ free ma mmarima ne mmaa ne abusua.
sort-together.short: Fa mfonini biara kɔ ne baskit mu: aduane anaa akyirikyiri, ne afoforo.
sort-together.intro: Hyehyɛ yɛ adwuma a wɔn a wɔadi so hu sɛ ɛyɛ anigye, te sɛ sɛ wobɛdan aduane anaa sɛ wobɛhyehyɛ sɔksɔ. Tow mfonini bi, afei tow baskit a ɛfata ho. Ɛnhia sɛ wodi ntɔ mmirika, na ɛnni akwan a ɛyɛ basaa.
howTo: Paw asɛmfua bi: aduane ne akyirikyiri, aburow ne mmoa, anaa fie ne akwantu.
Tow mfonini bi. Ɛbɛnya kɔnkɔn a ɛyɛ sikaa.
Tow baskit a ɛfata ho. Mfonini no bɛkɔ baskit no mu.
Sɛ ɛfata baskit foforo a, adwuma no bɛka no ne ɔkwan pa mu na ɛbɛtwɛn.
Sɛ mfonini nyinaa ahyehyɛ a, hwɛ baskit no mu bom.
tips: Wɔ asetena mu no, mmuae a ɛyɛ basaa nni hɔ bebree. Sɛ obi ka sɛ kanea a wɔnsɔ nsuo no fata aduane mu a, bisa no nsɛnkyerɛ. Ebia wobɛka abakɔsɛm pa.
Fa mfonini no sɛ ɛbɛboa wo asɛm: "Dɛn na woduaa wɔ wo kuruwa mu?"
Sɛ wohyehyɛ nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ, te sɛ nkɔnsɔ ne nnobɔfɔ anaa nkɔsɛeɛ a ɛyɛ mmaa, ɛyɛ adwuma a ɛyɛ anigye a wobɛtoa so esiane fɛn no nti.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ bere anaa nkontaabu?
faq.a: Dabi. Ɛnni bere, nkontaabu, mmuaeɛ kɔkɔɔ anaa ɔhwere. Wobɛtumi asiesie bere biara, na sɛ wosiesie wɔ ɛkyɛn a, ɛyɛ ɔkwan pa sɛ wobɛtwa.

faq.q: Dɛn nti na ɛyɛ hyehyɛ?
faq.a: Nnipa bebree ani gye hyehyɛ esiane sɛ ɛte sɛ adwuma a ɛyɛ mfaso na wɔadi so hu. Ɛyɛ mmerɛ nso sɛ wobɛka mfonini no ho asɛm bere a worehyehyɛ.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ bɛn, na ɛhia sɛ mede account bɔ?
faq.a: Aane, ɛnhwɛ tua biara, na ɛnhia account, sign-up anaa download. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ web browser wɔ foon, tablet anaa kɔmputa so.

picture-puzzle.name: Mfonini puzzle
picture-puzzle.seoTitle: Jigsaw a Ɛyɛ Mmerɛw wɔ Intaanɛt: Nkyɛmu 4 anaa 9 a Ɛyɛ Kɛse
picture-puzzle.h1: Mfonini Puzzle: Puzzle a Ɛyɛ Mmerɛ
picture-puzzle.description: Jigsaw a ɛyɛ mmerɛw wɔ intaanɛt ma mmarima ne mmaa: nkyɛmu 4 anaa 9 a ɛyɛ kɛse, mfonini nyinaa hwɛ, na wode tɔ nkyɛmu mmienu de sesa ne ho. Fa wo ankasa mfonini a ɛbɛgyina device yi so. Ɛyɛ free, ɛnni bere.
picture-puzzle.short: Tow mfonini abien de sesa wɔn kosi sɛ mfonini no yɛ pɛ.
picture-puzzle.intro: Mfonini a ɛyɛ dɛ bɛbɔ kɔ nkyɛmu anan anaa nkyɛmu nkron, na ɛbɛsesa. Mfonini nyinaa hyɛ hɔ sɛ kwan a wobɛhwɛ. Tɔ nkyɛmu baako, na tɔ foforo, na wɔsesa beaeɛ. Ɛnhia sɛ wodi nkyɛmu. Wobetumi nso de wo ankasa mfonini biara. Ɛbɛgyina device no so, na wɔrentumi nsoma.
howTo: Paw mfonini bi ne mfonini 4 anaa 9. 4 yɛ ɔkwan pa a ɛyɛ mmerɛ sɛ wɔrehyɛ ase.
Hwɛ mfonini no nyinaa a ɛwɔ soro.
Tow mfonini bi, afei tow beae a ɛsɛ sɛ ɛkɔ. Mfonini abien no bɛsesa wɔn.
Mfonini a ɛwɔ beae a ɛfata mu no bɛnya sɛ kɔnkɔn ketewa.
Sɛ mfonini no yɛ pɛ a, di no ho anigye bom, afei paw foforo.
tips: Sɛ wotow mfonini abien de sesa wɔn no ye sen sɛ wobɛsɔ wɔn ma nnipa bebree.
Ka mfonini no ho asɛm bere a ɛreba pɛ: "Hwɛ ntoma a ɛyɛ kɔkɔɔ no."
Puzzle a ɛyɛ nkwadaa a ɛwɔ mfonini 12 kosi 24 a ɛyɛ kɛse nso yɛ adwuma a ɛyɛ anigye wɔ tebele so.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ bere anaa nkontaabu?
faq.a: Dabi. Ɛnni bere, nkontaabu, mmuaeɛ kɔkɔɔ anaa ɔhwere. Wobɛtumi asiesie bere biara, na sɛ wosiesie wɔ ɛkyɛn a, ɛyɛ ɔkwan pa sɛ wobɛtwa.

faq.q: Ɛhia sɛ mekɔ mfonini no so?
faq.a: Dabi. Tow mfonini bi, afei tow foforo, na wɔbɛsesa wɔn. Eyi ye sen ma nnipa a wɔn nsa rebɔ anaa wɔ foon ketewa so.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ bɛn, na ɛhia sɛ mede account bɔ?
faq.a: Aane, ɛnhwɛ tua biara, na ɛnhia account, sign-up anaa download. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ web browser wɔ foon, tablet anaa kɔmputa so.

finish-the-saying.name: Kyerɛ asɛm no awiei
finish-the-saying.seoTitle: Ma Ntease No Awiei: Ntease a Wunim
finish-the-saying.description: Mmebusɛm a wɔbɛhunu, a ɛwɔ ne nsɛnkyerɛ a ɛdi awiei no ahyɛ hɔ, te sɛ mmebusɛm bi a ɛdi awiei nsɛm no ahyɛ hɔ. Tow nkyerɛaseɛ bi anaa hwɛ awiei no, afei ka ho asɛm.
finish-the-saying.short: Ka mmebusɛm a wɔbɛhunu bom, afei ka ho asɛm.
finish-the-saying.intro: Mmebusɛm a wɔka no bere tenten no, nnipa bebree da so hu. Kaad biara kyerɛ mmebusɛm bi a ɛdi awiei nsɛm no ahyɛ hɔ, nkyerɛaseɛ abiɛsa, ne botaan a ɛka sɛ "Kyerɛ awiei no". Awiei no akyi, asɛmmisa a ɛyɛ mmerɛ bɛma nkitahodie aba.
howTo: Ka mmebusɛm no mu kɔ ɛnyimu bom.
Tow asɛm a ɛmá no ayɛ awiei, anaa tow "Kyerɛ awiei no".
Ka mmebusɛm no mu bio bom, na ka ho asɛm sɛnea asɛmmisa no kyerɛ.
Tow "Mmebusɛm a ɛdi so" sɛ wo ho ayɛ wo.
tips: Ka no mu bɔ mmɔden, na ma bere kakra ansa na wukyerɛ asɛm a ɛdi awiei no. Ebia nnipa bi bɛka no ansa na woakyerɛ.
Sɛ obi ka awiei a ɛyɛ soronko a, ani gye. Mmebusɛm ayɛ ahodoɔ wɔ fie anaa mpɔtam so.
Sɛ nnipa pii wɔ hɔ a, obi kenkan na afei nnipa nyinaa ka awiei no mu.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ bere anaa nkontaabu?
faq.a: Dabi. Ɛnni bere, nkontaabu, nkyerɛ ahodoɔ anaa nsɛnnennen. Wubetumi agyae bere biara, na sɛ wagyae wɔ ne mfiase mu no, ɛyɛ ɔkwan pa a wobɛtumi de awie so.

faq.q: Dɛn sɛ yɛpaw asɛmfua foforo?
faq.a: Dwumadi no kyerɛ asɛmfua no awiei a ɛte sɛ nea wɔtete, afei ɛkɔ nkɔmmɔ so. Nkontaabu nni hɔ, na asɛmfua a ɛyɛ soronko nso yɛ.

conversation-cards.short: Krataa a ɛwɔ mfonini ne nsɛmmisa a ɛyɛ mmerɛ. Ɛnni nsɛmmisa a wɔbɛbisa.
conversation-cards.intro: Krataa biara ka mfonini a wohu yiye ne nkɔmmɔ a wɔbɛfrɛ wo sɛ wo nkasa, sɛ "Ɛdɛn na wo pɛ wɔ ewiase tebea mu?" Nnuani biara nni hɔ, na ɛnni ntease a wobɛkae. Paw tebea anaa twa krataa nyinaa dwa.

Kenkan nsɛm no ma wɔn tie, na hwɛ mfonini no mu bom.

Fa "Twa krataa nyinaa dwa" de krataa a wɔatwa dwa ma wo.
tips: Ka wo ankasa mmuae nso. Ɛte sɛ nkɔmmɔ, ɛnyɛ nsɛmmisa.

faq.q: Adɛn nti na nsɛmmisa a ɛfa "Wokae…?" nni hɔ?

photo-pairs.description: Sesa wo ankasa abusua mfonini ayɛ ahyɛdeɛ a ɛyɛ dodo a wobɛhyɛ ho nkabom. Paw mfonini 2 kɔsi 6 wɔ wo foon, tablet anaa komputa so; wɔbɛtena wo browser mu na wɔnnsoma kɔ baabi biara.

photo-pairs.intro: Fa wo abusua mfonini mmienu kɔsi enum fi wo fon, tabuleti anaa kɔmputa so, na ɛbɛyɛ agyinasɛm a mfonini no yɛ kɛse na ɛhyɛ nkyerɛ. Sɛ wopɛ a, fa nsɛm kakra kyerɛw wɔ mfonini biara ase, na sɛ wɔatwa bere a, nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛyɛ mmerɛw bɛkyerɛ wo baabi a awɔ mfonini awie. Eyi yɛ akwan a wɔfa so hwɛ abusua mfonini ne ho.
howTo: Tia "Yi mfonini" na fa mfonini mmienu kɔsi enum.
Mfonini biara bɛba ɛsɛ mmienu. Tia baako, lĩ tia ne kabo.
Sɛ wopɛ a, fa nsɛm kakra kyerɛw wɔ mfonini biara ase. Wɔnnkora nsɛm no.

tips: Paw mfonini a ɛyɛ mpɛn, a ɛfa nneɛma a wɔn ho yɛ hɔ: aboa, turo, baabi a ɔpɛ, anaa da a ɔware.
Mfonini a ɛfa baabi ne nneɛma yɛ fɛ sen anifuraa, na ɛnhyɛ obi so ahohia sɛ ɔbɛka din.
Gyae mfonini a ɛfa nnipa a wɔawu no ho, sɛ ɛbɛma ɔyaw kɛse ba ntɛm, gyae sɛ wunim sɛ ɛde ahomegyé ba.

faq.q: Wɔsoma me mfonini baabi biara anaa?
faq.a: Daabi. Saa nkyerɛwee no kenkan mfonini a wopaw wɔ wo browser mu na ɛda wɔn ano wɔ wo ahyia so. Wɔnnsoma kɔ yɛn anaa obiara nkyɛn, na wɔbɛtwam bere a wotwe anaa wosan de saa nkyerɛwee no bɛba.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ bere anaa nkontaabu?

faq.q: Metumi asie ahyɛdeɛ no ama bere a edi hɔ?

picture-bingo.intro: Bingo a ɛte sɛ ɛtɔ da, nanso mfonini na ɛwɔ baabi a nɔma wɔ. Enti obiara nhia sɛ ɔkenkan nsɛm ketewa. Print kaad a ɛnyɛ pɛ, afei fa caller a ɛwɔ skrini so de kyerɛ mfonini biara kɛse wɔ TV, laptop anaa tablet so.
howTo: Paw mpɔn 9 anaa 16 wɔ kaad biara mu, ne nnipa dodow.
Fa "Print kaad" so. Kaad biara yɛ soronko.
Bue caller no wɔ skrini kɛse so. Fa "Mfonini a edi so" so de kyerɛ mfonini biara ne din.
Nnipa no bɛkata mfonini a ɛtɔ da no so wɔ wɔn kaad so, de sika, bɔtɔn anaa mmara.

tips: Fa nkɔsoɔ kɛse-kɛse, te sɛ checkers anaa bottle caps. Bɔtɔn ketewa yɛ den sɛ wobɛtumi akyer.

Fa nnipa a wɔhu ntɛm nni ho ma wɔtena skrini no ho ahyɛ, na fa mmoafo ka wɔn a wɔhia wɔn.
Mpɔn 9 ɛboro ma nnipa pii. Ma nhyiam no nkɔ mmɔden 20 kɔsi 30.

faq.q: Sɛn na mɛyɛ mfonini bingo wɔ adwumayɛbea a wɔhwɛ nnipa so?
faq.a: Print kaad biako ma obiara, de caller no kɔ skrini a ɛkɛse sen biara a wowɔ no so, na frɛ mfonini no mmɔden, de din a ɛbɛka biara. Kɔ so kɔsi sɛ obiara wɔ ɔkwan biako, na obiara nnyina mu.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ free sɛ metumi aprint?
faq.a: Aane. Print kaad a ɛho hia, bere a wopɛ, ma wo ankasa anaa ma nnipa a wɔne wo, sɛ ɛyɛ personal anaa nkabom.

faq.q: Nnipa tumi tɔ a wɔnkenkan?
faq.a: Aane. Mpɔn biara yɛ mfonini kɛse, ne din wɔ ase ma wɔn a wɔpɛ nsɛm.

picnic-planner.name: Ahomegyebɔ nhyehyɛe
picnic-planner.seoTitle: Ahomegyebɔ Nhyehyɛe: Paw Mfonini ma Nnwuma Bi
picnic-planner.h1: Ahomegyebɔ Nhyehyɛe: Paw Mfonini, Then Wɔ Sɛ Wɔbɛtoto
picnic-planner.description: Paw aduane ne nneɛma a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ ahomegyebɔ mu mfonini, then wɔ ɔhaw kakra a ɛnyɛ den mu. Biribiara nnhwɛ bere. Ɛnhwɛ sika na wɔbɛprinti no.
picnic-planner.short: Paw aduane ne nnwuma a wɔbɛyɛ mfonini, then wɔ tototo.
picnic-planner.players: Wo nko ara, anaa nkurɔfo 2 wɔ mu ho
picnic-planner.intro: Tia aduane ne nneɛma a wɔbɛyɛ mfonini de wɔn ahyɛ ahomegyebɔ basket mu, a ɛbɛyɛ mfonini ahyɛ ano kosi nsia. Nsɛmfua a wɔkyerɛw kyerɛ nea ɛwɔ basket mu, te sɛ "Yɛn ahomegyebɔ: paanoo, warankɔ, apɔw ne kite." Then tia "Momma yɛntoto yɛn ahomegyebɔ" de nyɛ tototo a ɛyɛ mmerɛw fi mfonini a woapaw no so. Mfonini no tena hɔ, na wɔnnhwɛ bere, nnhwɛ nkyɛ anaa wɔnnkora. "Printi yɛn ahomegyebɔ tɛtrɛwɔ" printi nkyerɛwde a ɛkyerɛ nea woapaw, ne tiaboɔ biara a ɛwɔ hɔ ma nneɛma a wɔbɛkɔ de.
howTo: Tia aduane anaa nneɛma a wɔbɛyɛ mfonini. Ɛbɛkɔ basket mu.
Tia mfonini a ɛwɔ basket mu de yi no fi hɔ.
Paw nneɛma nnan a ɛka ho, then tia "Momma yɛntoto yɛn ahomegyebɔ".
Tia mfonini mmienu a ɛte sɛ ɛmu. Mfonini no tena hɔ, enti ɛnhia sɛ wokae biribi.
Tia "Printi yɛn ahomegyebɔ tɛtrɛwɔ" de nkyerɛwde a wobɛfa kɔ wo nkyɛn.
tips: Bisa nkurɔfo a mo ne wɔn di so sɛ wɔpɛ sɛ wɔde biribiara bɛba, then paw mfonini no mu bɛyɛ mo nyinaa.
Ka mfonini biara ho asɛm bere a ɛkɔ basket mu: "Wo kae kite a yɛtuu wɔ supɔw so no anaa?"
Wɔ nkyerɛwde so no, nkyɛn a ɛnni nkyerɛwde no yɛ ma biribiara foforo a wopɛ sɛ wobɛfa kɔ anaa ma din.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ bere nhwɛfoɔ, nkontaabu anaa obi a ɔdi nkonim?

faq.q: Ɛyɛ aduane nhyehyɛe bi anaa?
faq.a: Dabi. Ɛyɛ mfonini nhyehyɛe ma ahomegyebɔ, a wɔbɛka ho asɛm na wɔde bɛkɔ nkyerɛwde so. Ɛnkyerɛ nea obiara bɛdi.

faq.q: Wɔkora anaa wɔsoma mfonini a yɛpaw no?
faq.a: Dabi. Basket no tena saa kratafa yi nko ara. Wɔnnkora, wɔnnsoma anaa wɔnnkyɛ kɔ obiara nkyɛn, na ɛbɛyera bere a woatwa kratafa no.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ nkyerɛwde mu version bi anaa?
faq.a: Dabi. "Printi yɛn ahomegyebɔ tɛtrɛwɔ" printi kratafa baako, wɔ A4 anaa US Letter so. Ɛkyerɛ mfonini a woapaw, tiaboɔ biara ne nkyɛn a ɛnni biribiara a ɛwɔ hɔ.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ free anaa ɛhia sɛ wokyerɛw din?

scrapbook.name: Nkaeɛ Buk
scrapbook.seoTitle: Nkaeɛ Buk: Fa Abusua Mfonini Di Dwuma Bom, Kratafa Biara
scrapbook.h1: Nkaeɛ Buk: Fa Wo Mfonini ne Nsɛm Ka, Then Kratafa No
scrapbook.description: Paw wo abusua mfonini mmienu kɔsi mmienu wɔ wo dwumadie so, na fa sɛ buk di dwuma, nsɛm kakra wɔ ase biara. Wɔnkɔ so nkɔ. Ɛnhia sika sɛ wobɛprinti.
scrapbook.short: Di wo abusua mfonini so bom sɛ buk.
scrapbook.players: Wo nko ara, anaa nkurɔfo 2 wɔ mu ho
scrapbook.intro: Paw wo mfonini mmienu kɔsi mmienu fi saa dwumadie yi so. Mfonini biara bɛyɛ buk kratafa baako, kɛse sɛnea wobɛhu, na nsɛm kakra a wopɛ bɛyɛ ase. Di kratafa no so with nkyerɛwde anaa akyi nsɛnkyerɛnne, na fa "Hwɛ bom" de hwɛ mfonini ne nsɛm nko ara sɛ mo ne mo nkyɛn. Wo mfonini tena saa dwumadie yi so. Wɔnnkora wɔn anaa wɔnnsie wɔn, na buk no bɛyera bere a woatwa kratafa no. "Printi nkaeɛ buk" printi mfonini baako ne ne nsɛm wɔ kratafa biara so, ne kratafa nkyerɛwde.
howTo: Tia "Yi mfonini" na paw mfonini mmienu kɔsi mmienu. Bisa ansa na wofa mfonini a ɔnkɔ so mmuaa a ɔnkyɛ nkɔ.
Di kratafa so so with "Kratafa a atwam" ne "Kratafa a ɛbɛba", anaa nsakraeɛ a ɛfa nifa ne nifa a ɛfa mfinimfini so.
Fa nsɛm kakra kyerɛw wɔ mfonini ase sɛ wopɛ. Fa "Kɔ anim" anaa "Kɔ akyiri" sesa nhyehyɛe no.
Tia "Hwɛ bom" de yi nneɛma a wɔsesa no fi hɔ na hwɛ buk no mu wɔ ɔfa so.
Tia "Printi nkaeɛ buk" de yɛ kɔpi a wɔde ka ho, anaa "Yi buk no fi hɔ" sɛ woawie. Biribiara nnkora hɔ.
tips: Paw mfonini a ɛyɛ anigyeɛ na ɛyɛ wo ho nim, te sɛ afuw, aboa, anaa beaeɛ a wopɛ paa. Wɔ krataa biara so a, ka ho asɛm.
Ma nea wɔn ho yɛ hia no nka nsɛm bi ma krataa biara, ɛwom sɛ ɛyɛ asɛm baako nko. Kyerɛw no pefee sɛnea ɔka no.
Sɛ ɛyɛ krataa so a, wobetumi de krataa a wɔaprin no ahyɛ folda mu, na mmusuakuw no nso wɔn ho mfonini ne ankyerɛwde ka ho.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ bere a wɔhwɛ, nkontaabu, anaa obi a ɔdi nkonim?
faq.a: Daabi. Bere biara nni hwɛ ho, nkontaabu biara nni ho, na obiara nni nkonim. Krataa akontaabu no wɔ hɔ de ma wo nim baabi a woreka wɔ nhoma no mu.

faq.q: Wɔkora, wɔde kɔ intanɛt so, anaa wɔsoma yɛn mfonini ne nkyerɛaseɛ?
faq.a: Daabi. Saa krataa yi nko na ɛkenkan mfonini no, na wɔnnkɔ intanɛt so, wɔnnsie wɔ hɔ, na wɔnnsoma baabi biara. Nkyerɛaseɛ no kora nko ara bere a krataa no wɔ hɔ. Sɛ wobɛtwa krataa no a, nhoma no nso kɔ.

faq.q: Yɛbɛtumi aprin nhoma no?
faq.a: Aane. "Prin mfonini nhoma no" de mfonini baako ne ne nkyerɛaseɛ kɔ krataa biara so, akontaabu nso wɔ hɔ. Fa A4 anaa US Letter wɔ prinkyɛ nhyehyɛe no mu.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ free, na ɛhia sɛ wobue account anaa wokyerɛw wo din?
faq.a: Aane, ɛyɛ free, na account, sign-up anaa download biara nni hɔ. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ web browser so wɔ foon, tablet anaa komputa so.

collage-board.name: Mfonini board
collage-board.seoTitle: Collage Board: Nnipa Mmienu Hyɛ Mfonini wɔ Board Baako So Nkyɛn-nkyɛn
collage-board.h1: Collage Board: Hyɛ Mfonini wɔ Board Baako So, Nkyɛn-nkyɛn
collage-board.description: Nnipa mmienu hyɛ mfonini a wɔatwa no wɔ board baako so nkyɛn-nkyɛn. Tɛ mfonini a wɔatwa no, afei tɛ beaeɛ a ɛnni hɔ. Ɛnni bere anaa nkontaabu. Ɛyɛ free sɛ wobɛtumi de ayɛ adwuma na aprin.
collage-board.short: Nnipa mmienu hyɛ mfonini wɔ board baako so nkyɛn-nkyɛn.
collage-board.intro: Nnipa mmienu tena ɔfa baako so, wɔ board baako a ɛwɔ beaeɛ dummienu ne tray a ɛwɔ mfonini awotwe a wɔatwa no. Tɛ mfonini a wɔatwa no, afei tɛ beaeɛ a ɛnni hɔ, na mfonini no kɔ hɔ. Afei, nea ɛtɔ so no yɛ obi a ɔtena ho. Nnipa biara mfonini wɔ ne ntoma, ɛyɛ ɔkɔnkɔnsɛ anaa ɔpɛnsɛ, sɛnea board no bɛkyerɛ nea obi hyɛɛ hɔ, na ɛnhwɛ langa so. Obiara betumi agyae, na ɛtumi ma wɔsan de anammɔn baako adan. Bere, nkontaabu anaa nkyerɛaseɛ biara nni hɔ, na wɔnnkora hɔ. "Prin board no" prints board a ɛnni hɔ ne mfonini a wɔbɛtwa.
howTo: Tɛ mfonini a wɔatwa no wɔ tray no mu. Ɛkyerɛ "Wɔapɛ" bere a wɔapɛ no.
Tɛ beaeɛ a ɛnni hɔ wɔ board no so. Mfonini no kɔ hɔ, na nea ɛtɔ so no yɛ obi a ɔtena ho.
Obiara betumi atɛ "Gyae" bere biara, anaa "Yi nea ɛto so akyire yi fi hɔ" de yi anammɔn baako fi hɔ.
Tɛ "Mfonini afoforo nhyehyɛe" ma tray foforo. Mfonini a ɛwɔ board so no bɛtena baabi a ɛwɔ.
Tɛ "Fi ase bio" de siesie board no, na "San de hɔ" sɛ wosesa wo adwene.
tips: Ka mfonini biara din bere a ɛrekɔ fam, te sɛ "kapu no wɔ fie no akyi". Nkasa ma ɛyɛ adwuma a wɔyɛ bom.
Ma nnipa mmienu no nyinaa nnwe mfonini a wɔbɛtwa ne beaeɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ, na obiara nya ne deɛ aka ho.
Sɛ ɛyɛ krataa so a, ɔpanyin bi bɛboa wo de atwa mfonini awotwe no, afei hyɛ wɔ prin mu boxes no so.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ bere a wɔhwɛ, nkontaabu, anaa obi a ɔdi nkonim?
faq.a: Daabi. Bere biara nni hwɛ ho, nkontaabu biara nni ho, na obiara nni nkonim. Board a mfonini wɔ beaeɛ nyinaa so ara yɛ board a wɔama ayɛ.

faq.q: Wɔkora anaa wɔde kɔ so mfonini a yɛhyɛ?
faq.a: Daabi. Board no tena saa krataa yi so nko. Wɔnnsie wɔ hɔ, wɔnnde kɔ so, wɔnnkan hɔ, na ɛbɛyera sɛ wotwa krataa no atwa so.

faq.q: Yɛbɛhu sɛn na mfonini biara yɛ obi?
faq.a: Obiara wɔ ne ntoma. Nea ɔtɔ kan no mfonini wɔ ɔkɔnkɔnsɛ wɔ ntwaa mu, na nea ɔtɔ ɛto so no mfonini wɔ ɔpɛnsɛ, na wɔda wɔn din biara ka board no so.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ krataa so version?
faq.a: Aane. "Prin board no" prints board a ɛnni hɔ sɛ beaeɛ dummienu, na mfonini awotwe a ɛwɔ ase no yɛ kɛse baako, ne twa no nsɛnkyerɛnne. Ɔpanyin bi betumi atwa.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ free, na ɛhia sɛ wobue account anaa wokyerɛw wo din?
faq.a: Aane, ɛyɛ free, na account, sign-up anaa download biara nni hɔ. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ web browser so wɔ foon, tablet anaa komputa so.

garden-planner.name: Afuw nhyehyɛe
garden-planner.seoTitle: Garden Planner: Hyehyɛ Asase Bi Fi Afifide Mfonini So
garden-planner.h1: Garden Planner: Paw Mfonini na Hyehyɛ Asase Bi
garden-planner.description: Paw afifide ne afuw nneɛma mfonini, na hyɛ wɔn wɔ abɔde dummienu a ɛwɔ asase bi mu. Tɛ mfonini, afei tɛ abɔde. Ɛnni bere anaa nkontaabu. Ɛyɛ free sɛ wobɛtumi de ayɛ adwuma na aprin.
garden-planner.short: Paw afifide mfonini na hyehyɛ asase a ɛwɔ abɔde dummienu.
garden-planner.players: Ɔko, anaa 2 nnipa a wɔtena ɔfa baako so
garden-planner.intro: Paw mfonini fi tray a ɛwɔ afifide ne afuw nneɛma mu, afei tɛ abɔde biara de hyɛ mfonini biara wɔ beaeɛ. Asase bi wɔ abɔde dummienu, na abɔde biara gye mfonini baako. Nkyerɛwde a ɛwɔ hɔ kyerɛ nea nhyehyɛe no wɔ, te sɛ "Wo nhyehyɛe wɔ 3 nnwuma a ɛte sɛ ɔbɛnsɛ, 2 ahɔhoɔ ne 1 dua." Nkontaabu, bere anaa nkyerɛaseɛ biara nni hɔ, na ɛnni anammɔn. Eyi yɛ mfonini nhyehyɛe a wobɛka ho asɛm, na ɛnyɛ akwankyerɛ a ɛfa afifide dua ho. "Prin nhyehyɛe no" prints abɔde ne mfonini a wopaw, ne abɔde a ɛnni hɔ a wobɛtumi de adwuma, ne nkyerɛwde ahyɛ.
howTo: Tɛ mfonini a wɔatwa no wɔ tray no mu. Ɛkyerɛ "Wɔapɛ" bere a wɔapɛ no.
Tɛ abɔde. Mfonini no kɔ hɔ, na wɔde asi ho gyinaa.
Sɛ wobɛsesa abɔde, paw mfonini foforo, na tɛ abɔde no. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wuyi abɔde no ntɛ, tɛ no a wammpaw mfonini biara.
Tɛ "Fi ase bio" de yi abɔde nyinaa, na "San de hɔ" sɛ wosesa wo adwene.
Tɛ "Prin nhyehyɛe no" de nea wɔasiesie no ne nkyerɛwde ka no kɔ krataa so.
tips: Nɔ ɛnyɛ den sɛ wobɛka ɔfa biara wɔ nsɛnkyerɛ no ho. Nsɛnkyerɛ biara a ɛba mu no, ka ho asɛm, sɛ “aba no bɛkɔ ne ho wɔ ɔwɔ ho”. Nkɔmmɔ ma ɛyɛ adwuma a mo nyinaa mo ho wɔ mu.
Ma obiara ne ho paa nsɛnkyerɛ bi bere biara, anaasɛ mo nyinaa mopaw nsɛnkyerɛ no ho, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a mo mu biara bɛka ne nkɔso no ho.
Wɔ impɛpɛ so no, nsɛnkyerɛ a enni biribi mu no yɛ ma wo ankasa adwene, na mfuw a wɔatwa ho ahyɛnsoɔ no yɛ ma nkaeɛ biara a wopɛ sɛ wokae.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ wɔ afifide ho akwankyerɛ anaa?
faq.a: Dabi. Eyi yɛ nsɛnkyerɛ a wɔde nsɛnkyerɛ asɛm ho, na ɛnyɛ afifide ho akwankyerɛ. Ɛnka bere, beaeɛ anaasɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so de afifide biara to mu, efisɛ eyi gyina nea wodi asɛm wɔ hɔ so.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ bere, nkontaabu anaa ɔdɔm bi?
faq.a: Dabi. Wɔnhwɛ bere, wɔnkyerɛ nkontaabu, wɔnhwɛ ma ɔpɛ biara, na obiara nnya nkonimdi. Nsɛnkyerɛ a ɛyɛ ma nyinaa nso nni nkyerɛkyerɛ kɛse biara.

faq.q: Wɔbɛkora anaa wɔde nkɔ afa nsɛnkyerɛ a yɛpaw no?
faq.a: Dabi. Nhyehyɛe no te saa ara wɔ saa nkyɛn yi nkutoo so. Wɔnkora, wɔnsoma anaa wɔnkyerɛ, na ɛbɛyera bere a wobɛtwe saa nkyɛn yi.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ kyerɛwtohɔ a wɔbɛpem so anaa?
faq.a: Ɛwɔ. “Pem nhyehyɛe no” ma ɛpem kyerɛwtohɔ baako, A4 anaa US Letter. Ɛda mfuw aduasa abien a wɔawɔ ho ahyɛnsoɔ a wopaw no adi, nkyerɛase a ɛwɔ asɛm mu, ne mpɔtam a ɛwɔ hɔ ma nkaeɛ.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ ahofadi anaa ɛsɛ sɛ mekyerɛ din?
faq.a: Ɛyɛ, ɛyɛ ahofadi, na ɛnhia akaunt, din ankyerɛ anaasɛ sɛ wode ko. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ nhwehwɛmu ɔbrasɛe so wɔ foon, tablet anaa komputa so.

coloring-wall.name: Nkuruwa a nnipa pii bɛdaw
coloring-wall.seoTitle: Nkuruwa a Nnipa Pii Bɛdaw: Mfonini Baako a Nsa Pii Bɛdaw
coloring-wall.h1: Nkuruwa a Nnipa Pii Bɛdaw: Mfonini Kɛse Baako a Yɛdaw Bom
coloring-wall.description: Pem mfonini kɛse baako wɔ nkyɛn pii so, sɛnea abusua, kilaas anaa ɔhwɛ-a-wɔhwɛ fie bɛdaw nkuruwa baako bom. Ɛyɛ ahofadi sɛ wobɛpem. Nni bere anaa ɔdɔm.
coloring-wall.short: Pem mfonini kɛse baako wɔ nkyɛn so ma nnipa pii nndaw.
coloring-wall.players: Nnipa a wɔboaboa, wɔ ɔpon so anaa wɔ kuruwa so
coloring-wall.intro: Paw mfonini baako fi nkyɛn a wɔdaw so, na paw nkuruwa a ɛwɔ nkyɛn 4, 6 anaa 9. Pem nkuruwa no: nkyɛn a ɛdi kan kyerɛ sɛnea wɔbɛboa ho, na nkyɛn foforɔ biara yɛ mfonini kɛse no mu ɔfa baako, a ɛwɔ din te sɛ A1 wɔ n’akyi. Obiara daw nkyɛn baako anaa pii, wɔ kyɛmɛ biara ne mfonini biara mu. Afei, wɔbɛhyehyɛ nkyɛn no sɛnea din no kyerɛ, na wɔde tɛp to ɛkyɛn. Wɔnhwɛ bere, wɔnkyerɛ nkontaabu anaa wɔnkora.
howTo: Paw mfonini, afei paw nkyɛn a nkuruwa no wɔ.
Hwɛ ɛkwan a ɛwɔ so wɔ ahyɛnsoɔ no so, a ɛkyerɛ baabi a din biara fi.
Tɔ “Pem nkuruwa no” na pem nkyɛn nyinaa.
Ma obiara nkyɛn baako anaa pii nadaw. Kyɛmɛ ne ɔkwan nni ho hia sɛ ɛtɔ mu.
Hyehyɛ nkyɛn no sɛnea din no kyerɛ, na de tɛp to ɛkyɛn.
tips: Ma nkyɛn a ɛwɔ mfonini a ɛyɛ mmerɛw no obiara a ɔpɛ adwuma a ɛyɛ dwodwo, na ma nkyɛn a ɛyɛ nnansa no nkyɛn obiara a ɔpɛ.
Tew nkuruwa no baabi a obiara bɛhwɛ, na kasa fa nkyɛn no ho bom.
Paw nkuruwa a ɛyɛ kakraa ma ɔpon kakraa, na kɛse ma dan.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ bere, nkontaabu anaa ɔdɔm bi?
faq.a: Dabi. Wɔnhwɛ bere, wɔnkyerɛ nkontaabu, na obiara nnya nkonimdi. Nkuruwa no yɛ mfonini a nnipa pii daw.

faq.q: Wɔkora anaa wɔde nkɔ baabi biara?
faq.a: Dabi. Nkuruwa no yɛ wɔ saa nkyɛn yi nkutoo so. Wɔnkora, wɔnsoma anaa wɔnkyerɛ, na ɛbɛyera bere a wobɛtwe saa nkyɛn yi.

faq.q: Ɛsɛ sɛ kɔla no ne mu bɔ?
faq.a: Dabi. Obiara tumi de kɔla biara ne kwan biara. Nkyɛn no bɛka ho mu ka mfonini baako.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ kyerɛwtohɔ a wɔbɛpem so anaa?
faq.a: Ɛwɔ. Nkuruwa a wɔapem no ne akwan nyinaa: nkyɛn a ɛdi kan a nkyerɛkyerɛ ne ahyɛnsoɔ wɔ mu, ne nkyɛn biara ma mfonini no ho ɔfa biara.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ ahofadi anaa ɛsɛ sɛ mekyerɛ din?
faq.a: Ɛyɛ, ɛyɛ ahofadi, na ɛnhia akaunt, din ankyerɛ anaasɛ sɛ wode ko. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ nhwehwɛmu ɔbrasɛe so wɔ foon, tablet anaa komputa so.

quiet-shapes.name: Ahyɛde a ɛyɛ dwodwo
quiet-shapes.seoTitle: Ahyɛde a Ɛyɛ Dwodwo: Fa Ahyɛde Ka Mfonini Mu
quiet-shapes.h1: Ahyɛde a Ɛyɛ Dwodwo: Fa Nsɛso Ka Mfonini Mu
quiet-shapes.description: Fa ahyɛde a ɛyɛ mmerɛw ka fie, ɔpɔnkɔ, ɛnam ne afoforɔ a ɛwɔ mfonini mu so. Tɔ nsɛso baako, afei tɔ baabi a ɛyɛ saa ahyɛde no. Nni bere anaa ɔdɔm. Ɛyɛ ahofadi sɛ wobɛdwe na wobɛpem.
quiet-shapes.short: Fa ahyɛde a ɛyɛ mmerɛw ka mfonini mu, de wo ntɛmpɛ.
quiet-shapes.intro: Mfonini baako a ɛwɔ ne nkyɛn, te sɛ fie, ɔpɔnkɔ anaa rɔkɛt, ayɛ nkyɛn. Nkyɛn biara wɔ nsɛso a ɛyɛ saa ahyɛde no: kɔnkɔnkɔnkɔn kɛse anaa kakraa, sikwɛ, parallelogram anaa sikwɛ mmɔden. Tɔ nsɛso baako, afei tɔ nkyɛn a ɛyɛ saa ahyɛde no, na ɛbɛka. Baabi a wotɔ no de nsɛso no bɛdan ma wo, enti ɛnhia sɛ wodwetɛ anaa wodan. Sɛ nsɛso no yɛ ahyɛde a ɛnyɛ saa nkyɛn no, ɛbɛtena sini mu wɔ ɔkyerɛwtohɔ tiaa mu. Wɔnhwɛ bere, wɔnkyerɛ nkontaabu, na wɔnkora anaa wɔnsoma. “Pem saa ahyɛde yi” pem mfonini ne nsɛso a ɛwɔ hɔ wɔ kyɛmɛ baako so, sɛ wobɛdaw anaa wobɛtwe.
howTo: Tɔ nsɛso baako wɔ sini mu. Ɛbɛkyerɛ “Wapaw” bere a wɔapaw no.
Tɔ baabi wɔ mfonini mu. Sɛ ahyɛde no yɛ saa, nsɛso no bɛka hɔ.
Sɛ ɛnyɛ saa a, sɔ baabi foforɔ. Ɛnnyae biribi sɛ wosɔ hwɛ.
Tɔ nsɛso a ɛwɔ mfonini mu de no ma ɛkɔ sini mu, anaa de “Fi ase bio” daa wɔn nyinaa ase.
Sɛ baabi biara wɔ nʼnsɛso a ɛfata no a, mfonini no awie. Tɔ “Ahyɛde foforɔ” ma ahyɛde foforɔ, anaa tɔ Rest de agyae.
tips: Turn the hint lines on to see each space. Turn them off for more of a puzzle, with only the outline to go by.
Start with the big shapes, such as the large triangles and the rectangles. The small pieces often go last.
Name the shapes out loud as you go: "a triangle, a square, a long rectangle". Talking can make it a shared activity.
On paper, color the pieces with two or three colors, or cut them out with an adult helping.

faq.q: Is there a timer, a score or a move count?
faq.a: No. Nothing is timed, counted or scored. A piece that does not fit is simply not placed, and you can stop whenever you like.

faq.q: Is anything we make saved or sent?
faq.a: No. The picture stays on this page only. It is not saved, uploaded or counted, and it is gone when you close the page.

faq.q: Are the places big enough for a tremor or a small screen?
faq.a: The outline is drawn as large as the screen allows, and each space is a button you can reach with a finger or with the Tab key. The pieces in the tray are the large buttons of the page.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Yes. "Print this shape" prints one picture on one page: the outline with its hint lines, and the pieces drawn at the same size beside it. Color the pieces, or cut them out to fit. An adult can do the cutting.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

calm-breathing.name: Ahome a ɛyɛ dodo
calm-breathing.seoTitle: A Calm Breathing Pause to Share
calm-breathing.description: Ahome a ɛyɛ dodo a wobɛhyɛ ho nkabom: mpɔn kɛse a ɛba ase ne ɛkɔ ase wɔ ahome mmɔden 6 mu. Wo na wɔfi ase, na wotumi gyae bere biara.
calm-breathing.short: Mpɔn a wobɛhome ne so. Fi ase anaa gyae sɛdeɛ wopɛ.
calm-breathing.intro: Ɛbaa mu sɛ ahyɛdeɛ a ɛyɛ papa ne dodo bere. Fa "Fi ase" so, hom bere a mpɔn no kɛse, na gyae bere a ɛba ase. Wotumi paw ntɛm anaa ntɛm nketewa. Ɛnyɛ ayaresa; ɛyɛ dodo bere a wobɛgye di.
howTo: Tena ase wɔ mpɛn mu bere a ɛyɛ fɛ.
Paw ntɛm: dodo anaa ntɛm.
Fa "Fi ase" so. Hom bere a mpɔn no kɛse, na gyae bere a ɛba ase.
Ɛbɛgyae ne ho wɔ mmɔden 6 ... anaa fa "Gyae" so bere biara a wopɛ.
tips: Fa nsa ka ne nsa anaa de nsa ka obi abɔ, sɛ ɛyɛ papa.
Mmɔ mmɔdenbɔ. Sɛ wɔpɛ sɛ wɔhwɛ nko ara a, ɛyɛ.
Sɛ obi wɔ ahome ho ɔhaw a, hom sɛdeɛ wɔyɛ bio na hwɛ mpɔn no nko. Bisa dɔkota ahome ho asɛm biara.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ ahome a ɛfa ayaresa ho?
faq.a: Daabi. Ɛyɛ bere a ɛyɛ ɔkwan, nea wɔpaw, ma ahomegyinaa ne nkitahodi. Ɛnyɛ ayaresa ma ahosu anaa yadeɛ biara. Kasa ne dɔkota ho yare nsɛm.

faq.q: Mpɔn no tu bere a metumi aka ... anaa?
faq.a: Dabi. Biribiara nnyin kɔsi sɛ woapɛ Fi ase, na ɛbɛgyae wɔ ahome nsia akyi anaa sɛ woapɛ Gyae. Sɛ wo device no ma nneyɛe a, nsɛm no sesa a ɔkɔ so nnyin.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ free, na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ akaunt?
faq.a: Aane, ɛyɛ free, na ɛnhia akaunt, sign-up anaa download. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ web browser a ɛwɔ foonsɛ, tablet anaa komputa so.

story-chain.name: Story chain
story-chain.seoTitle: Story Chain: a Shared Picture Story Game
story-chain.h1: Story Chain: Tell a Story One Picture at a Time
story-chain.description: A row of pictures grows one at a time, and each person says a sentence about it aloud. Nothing to type, no right answer. Free, calm, no timer and no score.
story-chain.short: Add a picture, then say a sentence each, taking turns.
story-chain.intro: The game starts with one picture and grows the chain one picture at a time. Each person says one sentence about the chain so far, out loud, in turn. A sentence can be about what you see, a place it brings to mind, or something silly. Nothing is typed, recorded or kept, there is no right answer, and anyone may pass. The chain stops at eight pictures, and then you can start a new one.
howTo: Look at the first picture together.
Take turns: each person says one sentence about the chain so far. Anyone may pass.
Tap "Add a picture" to put the next picture at the end of the chain.
Tap "Take the last one off" if you would rather go back a picture.
When the chain has eight pictures, tap "Start a new chain" for a fresh one, or simply stop.
tips: Short is fine: "Someone put the kettle on." The next person carries on, or passes.
Let the pictures lead. There is no story you are meant to arrive at.
Stop whenever you like. Stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Is anything typed or recorded?
faq.a: No. The sentences are spoken aloud and are not typed, recorded or sent anywhere. The game only shows the pictures.

faq.q: What if someone does not want to say anything?
faq.a: Anyone may pass, and the next person goes on. Nobody has to name or remember a picture.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

quiet-scene.seoTitle: Quiet Scene: One Picture at a Time
quiet-scene.h1: Quiet Scene: One Still Picture at a Time
quiet-scene.description: One large, still picture at a time, each with one gentle line under it. Press Next or Previous when you are ready. Nothing moves or plays on its own, and there is no timer or score. Free to play, with no account.
quiet-scene.short: Look at one still picture at a time, at your own pace.
quiet-scene.players: Alone, or a group in the same room
quiet-scene.intro: One large picture fills the screen, with one short line under it. Press "Next picture" or "Previous picture" when you are ready for another. Nothing moves, fades or changes on its own, and nothing is timed. Tap "Bigger picture" to show only the picture, so the whole room can see it on a television.
howTo: Look at the picture together.
Read the line under it aloud if you like.
Press "Next picture" or "Previous picture" when you are ready.
Tap "Bigger picture" to show only the picture, and "Show everything" to bring the rest back.
Stop whenever you like with "Done for now".
tips: Let the person choose when to move on: wait for them to look, then press Next.
For a group, use "Bigger picture" on a television or large screen and sit where everyone can see it.
There is no right way to look at a picture. Simply talking about one is a complete activity.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Does it play sound or move?
faq.a: No. There is no sound, and nothing moves, fades or changes by itself. A picture changes only when you press a button.

color-wash.name: Color wash
color-wash.seoTitle: Color Wash: Soft Color Across a Page
color-wash.h1: Color Wash: Paint Soft Color Across a Page
color-wash.description: A soft brush paints wide, see-through washes of color across one page, in four colors and two brush sizes. There is no end point, no score and no timer. Free to play, with no account.
color-wash.short: Paint soft washes of color across a page, at your own pace.
color-wash.players: Alone, or 2 people side by side
color-wash.intro: One page and one soft brush. Choose a color and a brush size, then drag across the page to lay down a wash of color. The page has no end point: there is nothing to finish, no picture to get right and no score. Lay down as many washes as you like, or put the brush down and simply look. A fresh page clears everything, and Put it back brings it back.
howTo: Choose a color. Each color has its written name.
Choose Wide or Very wide. Very wide covers more of the page with each stroke.
Drag across the page with a finger, a mouse or a pen to lay down a wash.
Or use the arrow keys to move the brush ring, and Space to put the brush down or up.
Tap "A fresh page" to clear the page, then "Put it back" if you want the washes back.
tips: Let the other person choose the color for the next wash, and talk about the colors as they go on.
Very wide is easier to steer with a shaky hand, because the brush does not need to be exact.
There is no right way to paint. Stop whenever you like, or tap "Done for now".

faq.q: Is there a finish, a score or a timer?
faq.a: No. The page has no end point. Nothing is finished, counted, timed or scored, and no message ever asks you to do more.

faq.q: Is the page saved or sent?
faq.a: No. Nothing is saved, printed or sent anywhere. The washes stay on this page until you leave it.

faq.q: Can I use this without a mouse or touch screen?
faq.a: Yes. When the page has focus, the arrow keys move a brush ring, and the Space key puts the brush down or up. The screen says "Brush down" or "Brush up" each time.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: No. Watercolor on paper is the same idea, a wet brush and one color at a time, so it is a different activity to try at the table.

faq.q: What colors are they?
faq.a: Yellow, orange, green and purple, the same four colors used in our other picture games. Each has a written name, and the name shows beside the choice.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.
